tr: Wallazeena yaqooloona Rabbanas rif 'annnaa 'azaaba Jahannama inn 'azaabahaa kaana gharaamaa
en: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;

ar: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
tr: Innahaa saaa'at mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa
en: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا
tr: Wallazeena izaaa anfaqoo lam yusrifoo wa lam yaqturoo wa kaana baina zaalika qawaamaa
en: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًۭا
tr: Wallazeena laa yad'oona ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara wa laa yaqtuloonan nafsal latee harramal laahu illaa bilhaqqi wa laa yaznoon; wa mai yaf'al zaalika yalqa asaamaa
en: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;

ar: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
tr: Yudaa'af lahul 'azaabu Yawmal Qiyaamati wa yakhlud feehee muhaanaa
en: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;

ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
tr: Illaa man taaba wa 'aamana wa 'amila 'amalan saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yubad dilul laahu saiyi aatihim hasanaat; wa kaanal laahu Ghafoorar Raheemaa
en: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

ar: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا
tr: Wa man taaba wa 'amila saalihan fa innnahoo yatoobu ilal laahi mataabaa
en: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًۭا
tr: Wallazeena laa yash hadoonaz zoora wa izaa marroo billaghwi marroo kiraamaa
en: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا
tr: Wallazeena izaa zukkiroo bi Aayaati Rabbihim lam yakhirroo 'alaihaa summanw wa'umyaanaa
en: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
tr: Wallazeena yaqooloona Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyaatinaa qurrata a'yuninw waj 'alnaa lilmuttaqeena Imaamaa
en: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَٰمًا
tr: Ulaaa'ika yujzawnal ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wa yulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyatanw wa salaamaa
en: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,

ar: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
tr: Khaalideena feehaa; hasunat mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa
en: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!

ar: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
tr: Qul maa ya'ba'u bikum Rabbee law laa du'aaa'ukum faqad kazzabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa
en: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.

ar: طسٓمٓ
tr: Taa-Seeen-Meeem
en: Ta. Sin. Mim.

ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
tr: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Mubeen
en: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.

ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
en: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.

ar: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
tr: In nashaa nunazzil 'alaihim minas samaaa'i Aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een
en: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.

ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
tr: Wa maa yaateehim min zikrim minar Rahmaani muhdasin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen
en: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.

ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
tr: Faqad kazzaboo fasa yaateehim ambaaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
en: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
tr: Awa lam yaraw ilal ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem
en: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Inn fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
en: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

ar: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
tr: Wa iz naadaa Rabbuka Moosaaa ani'-til qawmaz zaalimeen
en: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,

ar: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
tr: Qawma Fir'awn; alaa yattaqoon
en: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
tr: Qaala Rabbi inneee akhaafu ai yukazziboon
en: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,

ar: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
tr: Wa yadeequ sadree wa laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa arsil ilaa Haaroon
en: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).

ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
tr: Wa lahum 'alaiya zambun fa akhaafu ai yaqtuloon
en: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.

ar: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
tr: Qaala kallaa fazhabaa bi Aayaatinaaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon
en: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.

ar: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Faatiyaa Fir'awna faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen
en: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,

ar: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
tr: An arsil ma'anaa Baneee Israaa'eel
en: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.

ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
tr: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedanw wa labista feenaa min 'umurika sineen
en: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,

ar: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
tr: Wa fa'alta fa'latakal latee fa'alta wa anta minal kaafireen
en: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.

ar: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
tr: Qaala fa'altuhaaa izanw wa ana minad daaaleen
en: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.

ar: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
tr: Fafarartu minkum lam maa khiftukum fawahaba lee Rabbee hukmanw wa ja'alanee minal mursaleen
en: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).

ar: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
tr: Wa tilka ni'matun tamun nuhaa 'alaiya an 'abbatta Baneee Israaa'eel
en: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.

ar: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Qaala Fir'awnu wa maa Rabbul 'aalameen
en: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?

ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
tr: Qaala Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa in kuntum mooqineen
en: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.

ar: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
tr: Qaala liman hawlahooo alaa tastami'oon
en: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?

ar: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
tr: Qaala Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen
en: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.

ar: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
tr: Qaala inna Rasoolakumul lazee ursila ilaikum lamajnoon
en: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!

ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
tr: Qaala Rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi wa maa baina humaa in kuntum ta'qiloon
en: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.

ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
tr: Qaala la'init takhazta ilaahan ghairee la aj'alannaka minal masjooneen
en: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.

ar: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
tr: Qaala awalw ji'tuka bishai'im mubeen
en: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?

ar: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
tr: Qaala faati biheee in kunta minas saadiqeen
en: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!

ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
tr: Fa alqaa 'asaahu fa izaaa hiya su'baanum mubeen
en: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,

ar: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
tr: Wa naza'a yadahoo faizaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaa zireen
en: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.

ar: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
tr: Qaala lilmala-i hawlahooo inna haazaa lasaahirun 'aleem
en: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,

ar: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
tr: Yureedu ai yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaazaa taamuroon
en: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
tr: Qaalooo arjih wa akhaahu wab'as filmadaaa'ini haashireen
en: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners

ar: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
tr: Yaatooka bikulli sah haarin 'aleem
en: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.

ar: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
tr: Fa jumi'as saharatu limeeqaati Yawmim ma'loom
en: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.

ar: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
tr: Wa qeela linnaasi hal antum mujtami'oon
en: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?

ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
tr: La'allanaa nattabi'us saharata in kaanoo humul ghaalibeen
en: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
tr: Falammaa jaaa'as saharatu qaaloo li Fir'awna a'inna lanaa la ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen
en: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?

ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
tr: Qaala na'am wa innakum izal laminal muqarrabeen
en: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).

ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
tr: Qaala lahum Moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon
en: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!

ar: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
tr: Fa alqaw hibaalahum wa 'isiyyahum wa qaaloo bi'izzati Fir'awna innaa lanahnul ghaaliboon
en: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.

ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
tr: Fa alqaa Moosaa 'asaahu fa izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon
en: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show.

ar: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
tr: Fa ulqiyas saharatu saajideen
en: And the wizards were flung prostrate,

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbil 'aalameen
en: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,

ar: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
tr: Rabbi Moosaa wa Haaroon
en: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.

ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
tr: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'alla makumus sihra falasawfa ta'lamoon; la uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibanna kum ajma'een
en: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
tr: Qaaloo la daira innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa munqalliboon
en: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.

ar: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Innaa natma'u ai yaghfira lanaa Rabbunna khataa yaanaaa an kunnaaa awwalal mu'mineen
en: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.

ar: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
tr: Wa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadeee innakum muttaba'oon
en: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.

ar: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
tr: Fa arsala Fir'awnu filmadaaa'ini haashireen
en: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,

ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌۭ قَلِيلُونَ
tr: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i lashir zimatun qaleeloon
en: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,

ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
tr: Wa innahum lanaa laghaaa'izoon
en: And lo! they are offenders against us.

ar: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
tr: Wa innaa lajamee'un haaziroon
en: And lo! we are a ready host.

ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
tr: Fa akhrajnaahum min Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
en: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,

ar: وَكُنُوزٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
tr: Wa kunoozinw wa ma qaamin kareem
en: And treasures and a fair estate.

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
tr: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa Baneee Israaa'eel
en: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

ar: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
tr: Fa atba'oohum mushriqeen
en: And they overtook them at sunrise.

ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
tr: Falammaa taraaa'al jam'aani qaala as haabu Moosaaa innaa lamudrakoon
en: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.

ar: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
tr: Qaala kallaaa inna ma'iya Rabbee sa yahdeen
en: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.

ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
tr: Fa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa anidrib bi'asaakal bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kattawdil 'azeem
en: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.

ar: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
tr: Wa azlafnaa sammal aakhareen
en: Then brought We near the others to that place.

ar: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
tr: Wa anjainaa Moosaa wa mam ma'ahooo ajma'een
en: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;

ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
tr: Summa aghraqnal aakhareen
en: And We drowned the others.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaru hu mu'mineen
en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
en: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

ar: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
tr: Watlu 'alaihim naba-a Ibraaheem
en: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
tr: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa ta'budoon
en: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?

ar: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
tr: Qaaloo na'budu asnaaman fanazallu lahaa 'aakifeen
en: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.

ar: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
tr: Qaala hal yasma'oona kum iz tad'oon
en: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?

ar: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
tr: Aw yanfa'oonakum aw yadurroon
en: Or do they benefit or harm you?

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
tr: Qaaloo bal wajadnaaa aabaaa 'anaa kazaalika yaf'aloon
en: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.

ar: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
tr: Qaala afara 'aitum maa kuntum ta'budoon
en: He said: See now that which ye worship,

ar: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
tr: Antum wa aabaaa'ukumul aqdamoon
en: Ye and your forefathers!

ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Fa innahum 'aduwwwul leee illaa Rabbal 'aalameen
en: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
tr: Allazee khalaqanee fa Huwa yahdeen
en: Who created me, and He doth guide me,

ar: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
tr: Wallazee Huwa yut'imunee wa yasqeen
en: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.

ar: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
tr: Wa izaa mardtu fahuwa yashfeen
en: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,

ar: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
tr: Wallazee yumeetunee summa yuhyeen
en: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),

ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
tr: Wallazeee atma'u ai yaghfira lee khateee' atee Yawmad Deen
en: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.

ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
tr: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen
en: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.

ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
tr: Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen
en: And give unto me a good report in later generations.

ar: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
tr: Waj'alnee minw warasati Jannnatin Na'eem
en: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,

ar: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
tr: Waghfir li abeee innahoo kaana mind daalleen
en: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.

ar: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
tr: Wa laa tukhzinee Yawma yub'asoon
en: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,

ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
tr: Yawma laa yanfa'u maalunw wa laa banoon
en: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)

ar: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
tr: Illaa man atal laaha biqalbin saleem
en: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.

ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
tr: Wa uzlifatil Jannatu lilmuttaqeen
en: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).

ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
tr: Wa burrizatil Jaheemu lilghaaween
en: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.

ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
tr: Wa qeela lahum aina maa kuntum ta'budoon
en: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship

ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
tr: Min doonil laahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon
en: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?

ar: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
tr: Fakubkiboo feehaa hum walghaawoon
en: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers

ar: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
tr: Wa junoodu Ibleesa ajma'oon
en: And the hosts of Iblis, together.

ar: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
tr: Qaaloo wa hum feehaa yakkhtasimoon
en: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:

ar: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
tr: Tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen
en: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest

ar: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Iz nusawweekum bi Rabbil 'aalameen
en: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.

ar: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
tr: Wa maaa adallanaaa illal mujrimoon
en: It was but the guilty who misled us.

ar: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
tr: Famaa lanaa min shaa fi'een
en: Now we have no intercessors

ar: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍۢ
tr: Wa laa sadeeqin hameem
en: Nor any loving friend.

ar: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal mu'mineen
en: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatanw wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
en: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
tr: Kazzabat qawmu Noohinil Mursaleen
en: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
tr: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Noohun alaa tattaqoon
en: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
tr: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
tr: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon
en: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
en: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
tr: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
en: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

ar: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
tr: Qaalooo anu'minu laka wattaba 'akal arzaloon
en: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?

ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Qaala wa maa 'ilmee bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
en: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?

ar: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
tr: In hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa Rabbee law tash'uroon
en: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;

ar: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Wa maaa ana bitaaridil mu'mineen
en: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.

ar: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
tr: In ana illaa nazeerum mubeen
en: I am only a plain warner.

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
tr: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Noohu latakoonanna minal marjoomeen
en: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
tr: Qaala Rabbi inna qawmee kazzaboon
en: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.

ar: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Faftab bainee wa bai nahum fat hanw wa najjinee wa mam ma'iya minal mu'mineen
en: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.

ar: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
tr: Fa anjainaahu wa mamma'ahoo fil fulkil mashhoon
en: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
tr: Summa aghraqnaa ba'dul baaqeen
en: Then afterward We drowned the others.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
en: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
tr: Kazzabat 'Aadunil mursaleen
en: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
tr: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Hoodun alaa tattaqoon
en: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
tr: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
tr: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon
en: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Wa maa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
en: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

ar: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةًۭ تَعْبَثُونَ
tr: Atabnoona bikulli ree'in aayatan ta'basoon
en: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?

ar: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
tr: Wa tattakhizoona masaani'a la'allakum takhludoon
en: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever?

ar: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
tr: Wa izaa batashtum batashtum jabbaareen
en: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?

ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
tr: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
en: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
tr: Wattaqul lazeee amad dakum bimaa ta'lamoon
en: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,

ar: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَٰمٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
tr: Amaddakum bi an'aa minw wa baneen
en: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.

ar: وَجَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
tr: Wa jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
en: And gardens and watersprings.

ar: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
tr: Innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem
en: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.

ar: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
tr: Qaaloo sawaaa'un 'alainaaa awa 'azta am lam takum minal waa'izeen
en: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;

ar: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
tr: In haazaaa illaa khuluqul awwaleen
en: This is but a fable of the men of old,

ar: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
tr: Wa maa nahnu bimu 'azzabeen
en: And we shall not be doomed.

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Fakazzaboohu fa ahlaknaahum; inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
en: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
en: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
tr: Kazzabat Samoodul mursaleen
en: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
tr: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Saalihun alaa tattaqoon
en: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
tr: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
tr: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
en: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
en: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

ar: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
tr: Atutrakoona fee maa haahunnaaa aamineen
en: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,

ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
tr: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
en: In gardens and watersprings.

ar: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَنَخْلٍۢ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌۭ
tr: Wa zuroo inw wa nakhlin tal 'uhaa hadeem
en: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,

ar: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا فَٰرِهِينَ
tr: Wa tanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan faariheen
en: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?

ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
tr: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
en: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,

ar: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
tr: Wa laa tutee'ooo amral musrifeen
en: And obey not the command of the prodigal,

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
tr: Allazeena yufsidoona fil ardi wa laa yuslihoon
en: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
tr: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen
en: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;

ar: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
tr: Maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa faati bi Aayatin in kunta minas saadiqeen
en: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful.

ar: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
tr: Qaala haazihee naaqatul lahaa shirbunw w alakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom
en: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.

ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
tr: Wa laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa yaakhuzakum 'azaabu Yawmin 'Azeem
en: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.

ar: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَٰدِمِينَ
tr: Fa'aqaroohaa fa asbahoo naadimeen
en: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.

ar: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Fa akhazahumul 'azaab; inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum m'mineen
en: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
en: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
tr: kazzabat qawmu Lootinil mursaleen
en: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah),

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
tr: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Lootun alaa tattaqoon
en: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
tr: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen
en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
tr: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
en: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
en: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

ar: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Ataatoonaz zukraana minal 'aalameen
en: What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males,

ar: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
tr: Wa tazaroona maa khalaqa lakum Rabbukum min azwaajikum; bal antum qawmun 'aadoon
en: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk.

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
tr: Qaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Lootu latakoonanna minal mukhrajeen
en: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast.

ar: قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ
tr: Qaala innee li'amalikum minal qaaleen
en: He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct.

ar: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Rabbi najjjinee wa ahlee mimmmaa ya'maloon
en: My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.

ar: فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
tr: Fanajjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een
en: So We saved him and his household, every one,

ar: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
tr: Illaa 'ajoozan filghaabireen
en: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.

ar: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
tr: Summa dammarnal aa khareen
en: Then afterward We destroyed the others.

ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
tr: Wa amtarnaa 'alaihim mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen
en: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
en: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

ar: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
tr: Kazzaba As haabul Aykatil mursaleen
en: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
tr: Iz qaala lahum Shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon
en: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
tr: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
tr: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
en: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
en: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

ar: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
tr: Awful kaila wa laa takoonoo minal mukhsireen
en: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).

ar: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
tr: Wa zinoo bilqistaasil mustaqeem
en: And weigh with the true balance.

ar: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
tr: Wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa 'ahum wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen
en: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.

ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
tr: Wattaqul lazee khalaqakum waljibillatal awwaleen
en: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
tr: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen
en: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;

ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
tr: Wa maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa wa innazunnuka laminal kaazibeen
en: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.

ar: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
tr: Fa asqit 'alainaa kisafam minas samaaa'i in kunta minas saadiqeen
en: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.

ar: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Qaala Rabbeee a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon
en: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
tr: Fakazzaboohu fa akhazahum 'azaabu Yawmiz zullah; innahoo kaana 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeem
en: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
en: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Wa innahoo latanzeelu Rabbil 'aalameen
en: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,

ar: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
tr: Nazala bihir Roohul Ameen
en: Which the True Spirit hath brought down

ar: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
tr: 'Alaa qalbika litakoona minal munzireen
en: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,

ar: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
tr: Bilisaanin 'Arabiyyim mubeen
en: In plain Arabic speech.

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
tr: Wa innahoo lafee Zuburil awwaleen
en: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
tr: Awalam yakul lahum Aayatan ai ya'lamahoo 'ulamaaa'u Baneee Israaa'eel
en: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?

ar: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
tr: Wa law nazzalnaahu 'alaa ba'dil a'jameen
en: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,

ar: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Faqara ahoo 'alaihim maa kaanoo bihee mu'mineen
en: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
tr: Kazaalika salaknaahu fee quloobil mujrimeen
en: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.

ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
tr: Laa yu'minoona bihee hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem
en: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,

ar: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
tr: Fayaatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon
en: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.

ar: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
tr: Fa yaqooloo hal nahnu munzaroon
en: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?

ar: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
tr: Aafabi 'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon
en: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?

ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
tr: Aara'aita im matta'naahum sineen
en: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,

ar: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
tr: Summa jaaa'ahum maa kaanoo yoo'adoon
en: And then cometh that which they were promised,

ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
tr: Maaa aghnaaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yumaatoo'oon
en: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?

ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
tr: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa munziroon
en: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners

ar: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
tr: Zikraa wa maa kunnaa zaalimeen
en: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.

ar: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
tr: Wa maa tanazzalat bihish Shayaateen
en: The devils did not bring it down.

ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
tr: Wa maa yambaghee lahum wa maa yastatee'oon
en: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,

ar: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
tr: Innahum 'anis sam'i lama'zooloon
en: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.

ar: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
tr: Falaa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal mu'azzabeen
en: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.

ar: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
tr: Wa anzir 'asheeratakal aqrabeen
en: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,

ar: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Wakhfid janaahaka limanit taba 'aka minal mu'mineen
en: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.

ar: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Fa in asawka faqul innee bareee'um mimmmaa ta'maloon
en: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.

ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
tr: Wa tawakkal alal 'Azeezir Raheem
en: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.

ar: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
tr: Allazee yaraaka heena taqoom
en: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)

ar: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
tr: Wa taqallubaka fis saajideen
en: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).

ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
tr: Innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem
en: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.

ar: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
tr: Hal unabbi'ukum 'alaa man tanazzalush Shayaateen
en: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

ar: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ
tr: Tanazzalu 'alaa kulli affaakin aseem
en: They descend on every sinful, false one.

ar: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَٰذِبُونَ
tr: Yulqoonas sam'a wa aksaruhum aaziboon
en: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.

ar: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
tr: Washshu 'araaa'u yattabi 'uhumul ghaawoon
en: As for poets, the erring follow them.

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
tr: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiny yaheemoon
en: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,

ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
tr: Wa annahum yaqooloona ma laa yaf'aloon
en: And how they say that which they do not?

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
tr: Illal lazeena aamanoo w a'amilus saalihaati wa zakarul laaha kaseeranw wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo; wa saya'lamul lazeena zalamooo aiya munqalbiny yanqaliboon
en: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!

ar: طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
tr: Taa-Seeen; tilka Aayaatul Qur-aani wa Kitaabim Mubeen
en: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain;

ar: هُدًۭى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Hudanw wa bushraa lil mu'mineen
en: A guidance and good tidings for believers

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
tr: Allazeena yuqeemoonas Salaata wa yu'toonaz Zakaata wa hum bil Aakhirati hum yooqinoon
en: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
tr: Innal lazeena laa yu'mimoona bil Aakhirati zaiyannaa lahum a'maalahum fahum ya'mahoon
en: Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray.

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
tr: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena lahum sooo'ul 'azaabi wa hum fil Aakhirati humul akhsaroon
en: Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.

ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
tr: Wa innaka latulaqqal Qur-aana mil ladun Hakeemin 'Aleem
en: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware.

ar: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍۢ قَبَسٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
tr: Iz qaala Moosaa li ahliheee inneee aanastu naaran saaateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw aateekum bishihaabin qabasil la'allakum tastaloon
en: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Falammaa jaaa'ahaa noodiya am boorika man finnnnaari wa man hawlahaa wa Subhaanal laahi Rabbil 'aalameen
en: But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

ar: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
tr: Yaa Moosaaa innahooo Anal laahul 'Azeezul Hakeem
en: O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.

ar: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّۭ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًۭا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
tr: Wa alqi 'asaak; falammmaa ra aahaa tahtazzu ka annahaa jaaannunw wallaa mudbiranw wa lam yu'aqqib; yaa Moosaa laa takhaf innee laa yakhaafu ladaiyal mursaloon
en: And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence,

ar: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍۢ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
tr: Illaa man zalama summa baddala husnam ba'da sooo'in fa innee Ghafoorur Raheem
en: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful.

ar: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍۢ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
tr: Wa adkhil yadaka fee jaibika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairisooo'in feetis'i Aayaatin ilaa Fir'awna wa qawmih; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
en: And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe, it will come forth white but unhurt. (This will be one) among nine tokens unto Pharaoh and his people Lo! they were ever evil-living folk.

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةًۭ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
tr: Falammaa jaaa'at hum Aayaatunaa mubsiratan qaaloo haazaa sihrum mubeen
en: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,

ar: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًۭا وَعُلُوًّۭا ۚ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
tr: Wa jahadoo bihaa wastaiqanat haaa anfusuhum zulmanw-wa 'uluwwaa; fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mufsideen
en: And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers!

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًۭا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Wa laqad aatainaa Daawooda wa sulaimaana 'ilmaa; wa qaalal hamdu lil laahil lazee faddalanaa 'alaa kaseerim min 'ibaadihil mu'mineen
en: And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves!

ar: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
tr: Wa warisa Sulaimaanu Daawooda wa qaala yaaa aiyuhan naasu 'ullimnaa mantiqat tairi wa ooteenaa min kulli shai'in inna haazaa lahuwal fadlul mubeen
en: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour.

ar: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
tr: Wa hushira Sulaimaana junooduhoo minal jinni wal insi wattairi fahum yooza'oon
en: And there were gathered together unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order;

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌۭ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
tr: hattaaa izaaa ataw 'alaa waadin namli qaalat namlatuny yaaa aiyuhan namlud khuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum Sulaimaanu wa junooduhoo wa hum laa yash'uroon
en: Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving.

ar: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًۭا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
tr: Fatabassama daahikam min qawlihaa wa qaala Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mata kal lateee an'amta 'alaiya wa 'alaa waalidaiya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas saaliheen
en: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.

ar: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
tr: Wa tafaqqadat taira faqaala maa liya laaa aral hud hud, am kaana minal ghaaa'ibeen
en: And he sought among the birds and said: How is it that I see not the hoopoe, or is he among the absent?

ar: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
tr: La-u'azzibanahoo 'azaaban shadeedan aw la azbahannahoo aw layaatiyannee bisultaanim mubeen
en: I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse.

ar: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍۢ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍۢ يَقِينٍ
tr: Famakasa ghaira ba'eedin faqaala ahattu bimaa lam tuhit bihee wa ji'tuka min Sabaim binaba iny-yaqeen
en: But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings.

ar: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
tr: Innee wajattum ra atan tamlikuhum wa ootiyat min kulli shai'inw wa lahaa 'arshun 'azeem
en: Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne.

ar: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
tr: Wajattuhaa wa qawmahaa yasjudoona lishshamsi min doonil laahi wa zaiyana lahumush Shaitaanu a'maalahum fasaddahum 'anis sabeeli fahum laa yahtadoon
en: I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works fairseeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth), so that they go not aright;

ar: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
tr: Allaa yasjudoo lillaahil lazee yukhrijul khab'a fis samaawaati wal ardi wa ya'lamu maa tukhfoona wa maa tu'linoon
en: So that they worship not Allah, Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knoweth what ye hide and what ye proclaim,

ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۩
tr: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Azeem
en: Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Tremendous Throne.

ar: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
tr: Qaala sananzuru asadaqta am kunta minal kaazibeen
en: (Solomon) said: We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars.

ar: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَٰبِى هَٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
tr: Izhab bikitaabee haaza fa alqih ilaihim summma tawalla 'anhum fanzur maazaa yarji'oon
en: Go with this my letter and throw it down unto them; then turn away and see what (answer) they return,

ar: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَٰبٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
tr: Qaalat yaaa aiyuhal mala'u innee ulqiya ilaiya kitaabun kareem
en: (The Queen of Sheba) said (when she received the letter): O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
tr: Innahoo min Sulaimaana wa innahoo bismil laahir Rahmaanir Raheem
en: Lo! it is from Solomon, and lo! it is: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful;

ar: أَلَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
tr: Allaa ta'loo 'alaiya waa toonee muslimeen
en: Exalt not yourselves against me, but come unto me as those who surrender.

ar: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
tr: Qaalat yaaa aiyuhal mala'u aftoonee fee amree maa kuntu qaati'atan amran hattaa tashhhaddon
en: She said: O chieftains! Pronounce for me in my case. I decide no case till ye are present with me.

ar: قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أُو۟لُوا۟ قُوَّةٍۢ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
tr: Qaaloo nahnu uloo quwwatinw wa uloo baasin shadeed; wal amru ilaiki fanzuree maazaa taamureen
en: They said: We are lords of might and lords of great prowess, but it is for thee to command; so consider what thou wilt command.

ar: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا۟ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓا۟ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
tr: Qaalat innal mulooka izaa dakhaloo qaryatan afsadoohaa wa ja'alooo a'izzata ahlihaaa azillah; wa kazaalika yaf'aloon
en: She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do.

ar: وَإِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍۢ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
tr: Wa innee mursilatun ilaihim bihadiyyatin fanaaziratum bima yarji'ul mursaloon
en: But lo! I am going to send a present unto them, and to see with what (answer) the messengers return.

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍۢ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
tr: Falammaa jaaa'a Sulaimaana qaala atumiddoonani bimaalin famaaa aataakum bal antum bihadiy yatikum tafrahoon
en: So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon, (the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth? But that which Allah hath given me is better than that which He hath given you. Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift.

ar: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍۢ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةًۭ وَهُمْ صَٰغِرُونَ
tr: Irji' ilaihim falanaatiyan nahum bijunoodil laa qibala lahum bihaa wa lanukhri jannahum minhaaa azillatanw wa hum saaghiroon
en: Return unto them. We verily shall come unto them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from thence with shame, and they will be abased.

ar: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
tr: Qaala yaaa aiyuhal mala'u aiyukum yaateenee bi'arshihaa qabla ai yaatoonee muslimeen
en: He said: O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering?

ar: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ ۖ وَإِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمِينٌۭ
tr: Qaala 'ifreetum minal jinni ana aateeka bihee qabla an taqooma mim maqaamika wa innee 'alaihi laqawiyyun ameen
en: A stalwart of the jinn said: I will bring it thee before thou canst rise from thy place. Lo! I verily am strong and trusty for such work.

ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
tr: Qaalal lazee indahoo 'ilmum minal Kitaabi ana aateeka bihee qabla ai yartadda ilaika tarfuk; falammaa ra aahu mustaqirran 'indahoo qaala haazaa min fadli Rabbee li yabluwaneee 'a-ashkuru am akfuru wa man shakara fa innamaa yashkuru linafsihee wa man kafara fa inna Rabbee Ghaniyyun Kareem
en: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: I will bring it thee before thy gaze returneth unto thee. And when he saw it set in his presence, (Solomon) said: This is of the bounty of my Lord, that He may try me whether I give thanks or am ungrateful. Whosoever giveth thanks he only giveth thanks for (the good of) his own soul; and whosoever is ungrateful (is ungrateful only to his own soul's hurt). For lo! my Lord is Absolute in independence, Bountiful.

ar: قَالَ نَكِّرُوا۟ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
tr: Qaala nakkiroo lahaa 'arshahaa nanzur atahtadeee am takoonu minal lazeena laa yahtadoon
en: He said: Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will go aright or be of those not rightly guided.

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
tr: Falammaa jaaa'at qeela ahaakaza 'arshuki qaalat kaanna hoo; wa ooteenal 'ilma min qablihaa wa kunnaa muslimeen
en: So, when she came, it was said (unto her): Is thy throne like this? She said: (It is) as though it were the very one. And (Solomon said): We were given the knowledge before her and we had surrendered (to Allah).

ar: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍۢ كَٰفِرِينَ
tr: Wa saddahaa maa kaanat ta'budu min doonil laahi innahaa kaanat min qawmin kaafireen
en: And (all) that she was wont to worship instead of Allah hindered her, for she came of disbelieving folk.

ar: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Qeela lahad khulis sarha falammaa ra at hu hasibat hu lujjatanw wa khashafat 'an saaqaihaa; qaala innahoo sarhum mumarradum min qawaareer; qaalat Rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee wa aslamtu ma'a Sulaimaana lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
en: It was said unto her: Enter the hall. And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs. (Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass. She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself, and I surrender with Solomon unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
tr: Wa laqad arsalnaaa ilaa Samoda akhaahum Saalihan ani'budul lahha fa izaa hum fareeqaani yakhtasimoon
en: And We verily sent unto Thamud their brother Salih, saying: Worship Allah. And lo! they (then became two parties quarrelling.

ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
tr: Qaala yaa qawmi lima tasta'jiloona bissaiyi'ati qablal hasanati law laa tas taghfiroonal laaha la'allakum turhamoon
en: He said: O my people! Why will ye hasten on the evil rather than the good? Why will ye not ask pardon of Allah, that ye may receive mercy.

ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ ۚ قَالَ طَٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ تُفْتَنُونَ
tr: Qaalut taiyarnaa bika wa bimam ma'ak; qaala taaa'irukum 'indal laahi bal antum qawmun tuftanoon
en: They said: We augur evil of thee and those with thee. He said: Your evil augury is with Allah. Nay, but ye are folk that are being tested.

ar: وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍۢ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
tr: Wa kaana fil madeenati tis'atu rahtiny yufsidoona fil ardi wa laa yuslihoon
en: And there were in the city nine persons who made mischief in the land and reformed not.

ar: قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
tr: Qaaloo taqaasamoo billaahi lanubaiyitannahoo wa ahlahoo summaa lanaqoolana liwaliy yihee maa shahidnaa mahlika ahliee wa innaa lasaadiqoon
en: They said: Swear one to another by Allah that we verily will attack him and his household by night, and afterward we will surely say unto his friend: We witnessed not the destruction of his household. And lo! we are truthtellers.

ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًۭا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
tr: Wa makaroo makranw wa makarnaa makranw wa hum laa yash'uroon
en: So they plotted a plot: and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not.

ar: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
tr: Fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatu makrihim annaa dammar naahum wa qawmahum ajma'een
en: Then see the nature of the consequence of their plotting, for lo! We destroyed them and their people, every one.

ar: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ
tr: Fatilka buyootuhum khaa wiyatam bimaa zalamoo; inna fee zaalika la Aayatal liqaw miny-ya'lamoon
en: See, yonder are their dwellings empty and in ruins because they did wrong. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a people who have knowledge.

ar: وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
tr: Wa anjainal lazeena aamanoo wa kaanoo yattaqoon
en: And we saved those who believed and used to ward off (evil).

ar: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
tr: Wa lootan iz qaala liqawmiheee ataatoonal faa hishata wa antum qawmun tajjhaloon
en: And Lot! when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination knowingly?

ar: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةًۭ مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ تَجْهَلُونَ
tr: A'innakum lataatoonar rijaala shahwatam min doonin nisaaa'; bal antum qawmun tajhaloon
en: Must ye needs lust after men instead of women? Nay, but ye are folk who act senselessly.

ar: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌۭ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
tr: Fammaa kaana jawaaba qawmiheee illaaa an qaalooo akrijoon aalaa Lootim min qaryatikum innahum unaasuny yatatahharoon
en: But the answer of his folk was naught save that they said: Expel the household of Lot from your township, for they (forsooth) are folk who would keep clean!

ar: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَٰهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
tr: Fa anjainaahu wa ahlahooo illam ra atahoo qaddarnaahaa minal ghaabireen
en: Then We saved him and his household save his wife; We destined her to be of those who stayed behind.

ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
tr: Wa amtarnaa 'alaihimm mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen
en: And We rained a rain upon them. Dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.

ar: قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
tr: Qulil hamdu lillaahi wa salaamun 'alaa 'ibaadihil lazeenas tafaa; aaallaahu khairun ammmaa yushrikoon
en: Say (O Muhammad): Praise be to Allah, and peace be on His slaves whom He hath chosen! Is Allah best, or (all) that ye ascribe as partners (unto Him)?

ar: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍۢ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ يَعْدِلُونَ
tr: Amman khalaqas samaawaati wal arda wa anzala lakum minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa ambatnaa bihee hadaaa'iqa zaata bahjjah; maa kanna lakum an tumbitoo shajarahaa; 'a-ilaahum ma'al laah; bal hum qawmuny ya'diloon
en: Is not He (best) Who created the heavens and the earth, and sendeth down for you water from the sky wherewith We cause to spring forth joyous orchards, whose trees it never hath been yours to cause to grow. Is there any Allah beside Allah? Nay, but they are folk who ascribe equals (unto Him)!

ar: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًۭا وَجَعَلَ خِلَٰلَهَآ أَنْهَٰرًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
tr: Ammann ja'alal arda qaraaranw wa ja'ala khilaalahaaa anhaaranw wa ja'ala lahaa rawaasiya wa ja'ala bainal bahraini haajizaa; 'a-ilaahumma'allah; bal aksaruhum la ya'lamoon
en: Is not He (best) Who made the earth a fixed abode, and placed rivers in the folds thereof, and placed firm hills therein, and hath set a barrier between the two seas? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Nay, but most of them know not!

ar: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
tr: Ammany-yujeebul mud tarra izaa da'aahu wa yakshifussooo'a wa yaj'alukum khula faaa'al ardi 'a-ilaahum ma'al laahi qaleelam maa tazak karoon
en: Is not He (best) Who answereth the wronged one when he crieth unto Him and removeth the evil, and hath made you viceroys of the earth? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Little do they reflect!

ar: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ تَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
tr: Ammany-yahdeekum fee zulumaatil barri wal bahri wa many yursilu riyaaha bushram baina yadai rahmatih; 'a-ilaahum ma'al laah; Ta'aalal laahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
en: Is not He (best) Who guideth you in the darkness of the land and the sea, He Who sendeth the winds as heralds of His mercy? Is there any Allah beside Allah? High Exalted be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!

ar: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
tr: Ammmany-yabda'ul khalqa summa yu'eeduhoo wa many-yarzuqukum minas sammaaa'i wal ard; 'a-ilaahum ma'allah; qul haatoo burhaanakum in kuntum saadiqeen
en: Is not He (best) Who produceth creation, then reproduceth it, and Who provideth for you from the heaven and the earth? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Say: Bring your proof, if ye are truthful!

ar: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
tr: Qul laa ya'lamu mman fis sammaawaati wal ardil ghaiba illal laah; wa maa yash'uroona aiyaana yub'asoon
en: Say (O Muhammad): None in the heavens and the earth knoweth the Unseen save Allah; and they know not when they will be raised (again).

ar: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهَا ۖ بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ
tr: Balid daaraka 'ilmuhum fil Aakhirah; bal hum fee shakkim minhaa bal hum minhaa 'amoon
en: Nay, but doth their knowledge reach to the Hereafter? Nay, for they are in doubt concerning it. Nay, for they cannot see it.

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًۭا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ
tr: Wa qaalal lazeena kafarooo 'a-izaa kunnaa turaabanw wa aabaaa'unaaa a'innaa lamukhrajoon
en: Yet those who disbelieve say: When we have become dust like our fathers, shall we verily be brought forth (again)?

ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَٰذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
tr: Laqad wu'idnaa haazaa nahnu wa aabaaa'unaa min qablu in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen
en: We were promised this, forsooth, we and our fathers. (All) this is naught but fables of the men of old.

ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
tr: Qul seeroo fil ardi fanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mujremeen
en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see the nature of the sequel for the guilty!

ar: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِى ضَيْقٍۢ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
tr: Wa laa tahzan 'alaihim wa laa takun fee daiqim mimmaa yamkuroon
en: And grieve thou not for them, nor be in distress because of what they plot (against thee).

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
tr: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
en: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?

ar: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
tr: Qul 'asaaa any-yakoona radifa lakum ba'dul lazee tasta'jiloon
en: Say: It may be that a part of that which ye would hasten on is close behind you.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
tr: Wa innna Rabbaka lazoo fadlin 'alan naasi wa laakina aksarahum laa yashkuroon
en: Lo! thy Lord is full of bounty for mankind, but most of them do not give thanks.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
tr: Wa inna Rabbaka la ya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wa maa yu'linoon
en: Lo! thy Lord knoweth surely all that their bosoms hide, and all that they proclaim.

ar: وَمَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
tr: Wa maa min ghaaa'ibatin fis samaaa'i wal ardi illaa fee kitaabimm mubeen
en: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven or the earth but it is in a clear Record.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
tr: Inna haazal Qur-aana yaqussu 'alaa Baneee israaa'eela aksaral lazee hum feehi yakhtalifoon
en: Lo! this Qur'an narrateth unto the Children of Israel most of that concerning which they differ.

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Wa innahoo lahudanw wa rahmatul lilmu'mineen
en: And lo! it is a guidance and a mercy for believers.

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
tr: Inna Rabbaka yaqdee bainahum bihukmih; wa Huwal 'Azeezul 'Aleem
en: Lo! thy Lord will judge between them of His wisdom, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

ar: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلْمُبِينِ
tr: Fatawakkal 'alal laahi innaka 'alal haqqil mubeen
en: Therefor (O Muhammad) put thy trust in Allah, for thou (standest) on the plain Truth.

ar: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
tr: Innaka laa tusmi'ul mawtaa wa laa tusmi'us summad du'aaa izaa wallaw mudbireen
en: Lo! thou canst not make the dead to hear, nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call when they have turned to flee;

ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِى ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
tr: Wa maaa anta bihaadil 'umyi 'an dalaalatihim in tusmi'u illaa mai yu'minu bi aayaatinaa fahum muslimoon
en: Nor canst thou lead the blind out of their error. Thou canst make none to hear, save those who believe Our revelations and who have surrendered.

ar: ۞ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ
tr: Wa izaa waqa'al qawhu 'alaihim akhrajnaa lahum daabbatam minal ardi tukal limuhum annan naasa kaanoo bi aayaatinaa laa yooqinoon
en: And when the word is fulfilled concerning them, We shall bring forth a beast of the earth to speak unto them because mankind had not faith in Our revelations.

ar: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ فَوْجًۭا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
tr: Wa Yawma nahshuru min kulli ummmatin fawjam mim many-yukazzibu bi Aayaatinaa fahum yooza'oon
en: And (remind them of) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a host of those who denied Our revelations, and they will be set in array;

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا۟ بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'oo qaala akazzabtum bi Aayaatee wa lam tuheetoo bihaa 'ilman ammaazaa kuntum ta'maloon
en: Till, when they come (before their Lord), He will say: Did ye deny My revelations when ye could not compass them in knowledge, or what was it that ye did?

ar: وَوَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
tr: Wa waqa'al qawlu 'alaihim bimaa zalamoo fahum laa yantiqoon
en: And the Word will be fulfilled concerning them because they have done wrong, and they will not speak.

ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
tr: Alam yaraw annaa ja'alnal laila li yaskunoo feehi wannahaara mubsiraa; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil liqaw miny-yu'minoon
en: Have they not seen how We have appointed the night that they may rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Lo! therein verily are portents for a people who believe.

ar: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَٰخِرِينَ
tr: Wa Yawma yunfakhu fis Soori fafazi'a man fis samaawaati wa man fil ardi illaa man shaaa'al laah; wa kullun atawhu daakhireen
en: And (remind them of) the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and all who are in the heavens and the earth will start in fear, save him whom Allah willeth. And all come unto Him, humbled.

ar: وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةًۭ وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ
tr: Wa taral jibaala tahsabuhaa jaamidatanw wa hiya tamurru marras sahaab; sun'al laahil lazeee atqana kulla shai'; innahoo khabeerum bimaa taf'aloon
en: And thou seest the hills thou deemest solid flying with the flight of clouds: the doing of Allah Who perfecteth all things. Lo! He is Informed of what ye do.

ar: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٍۢ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ
tr: Man jaaa'a bilhasanati falahoo khairum minhaa wa hum min faza'iny Yawma'izin aaminoon
en: Whoso bringeth a good deed will have better than its worth; and such are safe from fear that Day.

ar: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Wa man jaaa'a bissai yi'ati fakubbat wujoohuhum fin Naari hal tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
en: And whoso bringeth an ill-deed, such will be flung down on their faces in the Fire. Are ye rewarded aught save what ye did?

ar: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
tr: Innamaaa umirtu an a'buda Rabba haazihil baldatil lazee harramahaa wa lahoo kullu shai'inw wa umirtu an akoona minal muslimeen
en: (Say): I (Muhammad) am commanded only to serve the Lord of this land which He hath hallowed, and unto Whom all things belong. And I am commanded to be of those who surrender (unto Him),

ar: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
tr: Wa an atluwal Qur-aana famanih tadaa fa innnamaa yahtadee linafsihee wa man dalla faqul innamaaa ana minal munzireen
en: And to recite the Qur'an. And whoso goeth right, goeth right only for (the good of) his own soul; and as for him who goeth astray - (Unto him) say: Lo! I am only a warner.

ar: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Wa qulil hamdu lillaahi sa yureekum Aayaatihee fata'ri foonahaa; wa maa Rabbuka bighaaflin 'ammaa ta'maloon
en: And say: Praise be to Allah Who will show you His portents so that ye shall know them. And thy Lord is not unaware of what ye (mortals) do.

ar: طسٓمٓ
tr: Taa-Seeen-Meeem
en: Ta. Sin. Mim.

ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
tr: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil mubeen
en: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.

ar: نَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
tr: Natloo 'alaika min naba-i Moosaa wa Fi'awna bilhaqqi liqawminy yu'miinoon
en: We narrate unto thee (somewhat) of the story of Moses and Pharaoh with truth, for folk who believe.

ar: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًۭا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةًۭ مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
tr: Inna Fir'awna 'alaa fil ardi wa ja'ala ahlahaa shiya'ai yastad'ifu taaa'ifatam minhum yuzabbihu abnaaa'ahum wa yastahyee nisaaa'ahum; innahoo kaana minal mufsideen
en: Lo! Pharaoh exalted himself in the earth and made its people castes. A tribe among them he oppressed, killing their sons and sparing their women. Lo! he was of those who work corruption.

ar: وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةًۭ وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
tr: Wa nureedu an namunna 'alal lazeenas tud'ifoo fil ardi wa naj'alahum a'immatanw wa naj'alahumul waariseen
en: And We desired to show favour unto those who were oppressed in the earth, and to make them examples and to make them the inheritors,

ar: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنُرِىَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَحْذَرُونَ
tr: Wa numakkina lahum fil ardi wa nuriya Fir'awna wa Haamaana wa junoodahumaa minhum maa kaanoo yahzaroon
en: And to establish them in the earth, and to show Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts that which they feared from them.

ar: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
tr: Wa awhainaaa ilaaa ummi Moosaaa an ardi'eehi faizaa khifti 'alaihi fa alqeehi filyammi wa laa takhaafee wa laa tahzaneee innaa raaaddoohu ilaiki wa jaa'iloohu minal mursaleen
en: And We inspired the mother of Moses, saying: Suckle him and, when thou fearest for him, then cast him into the river and fear not nor grieve. Lo! We shall bring him back unto thee and shall make him (one) of Our messengers.

ar: فَٱلْتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّۭا وَحَزَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰطِـِٔينَ
tr: Faltaqatahooo Aalu Fir'awna li yakoona lahum 'aduwwanw wa hazanaa; inna Fir'awna wa Haamaana wa junooda humaa kaanoo khaati'een
en: And the family of Pharaoh took him up, that he might become for them an enemy and a sorrow, Lo! Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts were ever sinning.
