en: And much booty that they will capture. Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.

ar: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا
tr: Wa'adakumul laahu ma ghaanima kaseeratan taakhuzoo nahaa fa'ajjala lakum haazihee wa kaffa aydiyan naasi 'ankum wa litakoona aayatal lilmu'mineena wa yahdiyakum siraatam mustaqeema
en: Allah promiseth you much booty that ye will capture, and hath given you this in advance, and hath withheld men's hands from you, that it may be a token for the believers, and that He may guide you on a right path.

ar: وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرًۭا
tr: Wa ukhraa lam taqdiroo 'alaihaa qad ahaatal laahu bihaa; wa kaanal laahu 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeera
en: And other (gain), which ye have not been able to achieve, Allah will compass it, Allah is Able to do all things.

ar: وَلَوْ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًۭا
tr: Wa law qaatalakumul lazeena kafaroo la wallawul adbaara summa laa yajidoona waliyanw-wa laa naseeraa
en: And if those who disbelieve join battle with you they will take to flight, and afterward they will find no protecting friend nor helper.

ar: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا
tr: Sunnatal laahil latee qad khalat min qablu wa lan tajida lisunnatil laahi tabdeelaa
en: It is the law of Allah which hath taken course aforetime. Thou wilt not find for the law of Allah aught of power to change.

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
tr: Wa Huwal lazee kaffa aydiyahum 'ankum wa aydiyakum 'anhum bibatni Makkata mim ba'di an azfarakum 'alaihim; wa kaanal laahu bimaa ta'maloona Baseera
en: And He it is Who hath withheld men's hands from you, and hath withheld your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after He had made you victors over them. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

ar: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌۭ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌۭ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٌۭ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
tr: Humul lazeena kafaroo wa saddookum 'anil-Masjidil-Haraami walhadya ma'koofan any yablugha mahillah; wa law laa rijaalum mu'minoona wa nisaaa'um mu'minaatul lam ta'lamoohum an tata'oohum fatuseebakum minhum ma'arratum bighairi 'ilmin liyud khilal laahu fee rahmatihee many yashaaa'; law tazayyaloo la'azzabnal lazeena kafaroo minhum 'azaaban aleema
en: These it was who disbelieved and debarred you from the Inviolable Place of Worship, and debarred the offering from reaching its goal. And if it had not been for believing men and believing women, whom ye know not - lest ye should tread them under foot and thus incur guilt for them unknowingly; that Allah might bring into His mercy whom He will - If (the believers and the disbelievers) had been clearly separated We verily had punished those of them who disbelieved with painful punishment.

ar: إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا
tr: Iz ja'alal lazeena kafaroo fee quloobihimul hamiyyata hamiyyatal jaahiliyyati fa anzalal laahu sakeenatahoo 'alaa Rasoolihee wa 'alal mu mineena wa alzamahum kalimatat taqwaa wa kaanooo ahaqqa bihaa wa ahlahaa; wa kaanal laahu bikulli shai'in Aleema
en: When those who disbelieve had set up in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance, then Allah sent down His peace of reassurance upon His messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of self-restraint, for they were worthy of it and meet for it. And Allah is Aware of all things.

ar: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًا
tr: Laqad sadaqal laahu Rasoolahur ru'yaa bilhaqq, latadkhulunnal Masjidal-Haraama in shaaa'al laahu aamineena muhalliqeena ru'oosakum wa muqassireena laa takhaafoona fa'alima maa lam ta'lamoo faja'ala min dooni zaalika fathan qareebaa
en: Allah hath fulfilled the vision for His messenger in very truth. Ye shall indeed enter the Inviolable Place of Worship, if Allah will, secure, (having your hair) shaven and cut, not fearing. But He knoweth that which ye know not, and hath given you a near victory beforehand.

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا
tr: Huwal lazeee arsala Rasoolahoo bilhudaa wa deenil haqqi liyuzhirahoo 'alad deeni kullih; wa kafaa billaahi Shaheeda
en: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion. And Allah sufficeth as a Witness.

ar: مُّحَمَّدٌۭ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًۭا سُجَّدًۭا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا
tr: Muhammadur Rasoolul laah; wallazeena ma'ahooo ashiddaaa'u 'alal kuffaaari ruhamaaa'u bainahum taraahum rukka'an sujjadany yabtaghoona fadlam minal laahi wa ridwaanan seemaahum fee wujoohihim min asaris sujood; zaalika masaluhum fit tawraah; wa masaluhum fil Injeeli kazar'in akhraja shat 'ahoo fa 'aazarahoo fastaghlaza fastawaa 'alaa sooqihee yu'jibuz zurraa'a liyagheeza bihimul kuffaar; wa'adal laahul lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati minhum maghfiratanw wa ajran 'azeemaa
en: Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. And those with him are hard against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. Thou (O Muhammad) seest them bowing and falling prostrate (in worship), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) acceptance. The mark of them is on their foreheads from the traces of prostration. Such is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel - like as sown corn that sendeth forth its shoot and strengtheneth it and riseth firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage the disbelievers with (the sight of) them. Allah hath promised, unto such of them as believe and do good works, forgiveness and immense reward.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
tr: Yaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo la tuqaddimoo baina yada yil laahi wa Rasoolihee wattaqul laah; innal laaha samee'un 'Aleem
en: O ye who believe! Be not forward in the presence of Allah and His messenger, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
tr: Yaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa tarfa'ooo aswaatakum fawqa sawtin Nabiyi wa laa tajharoo lahoo bilqawli kajahri ba'dikum liba 'din an tahbata a 'maalukum wa antum laa tash'uroon
en: O ye who believe! Lift not up your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout when speaking to him as ye shout one to another, lest your works be rendered vain while ye perceive not.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
tr: Innal lazeena yaghud doona aswaatahum 'inda Rasoolil laahi ulaaa'ikal lazeenam tah anal laahu quloobahum littaqwaa; lahum maghfiratunw waajrun 'azeem
en: Lo! they who subdue their voices in the presence of the messenger of Allah, those are they whose hearts Allah hath proven unto righteousness. Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
tr: Innal lazeena yunaadoo naka minw waraaa'il hujuraati aksaruhum laa ya'qiloon
en: Lo! those who call thee from behind the private apartments, most of them have no sense.

ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًۭا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
tr: Wa law annahum sabaroo hatta takhruja ilaihim lakaana khairal lahum; wallaahu Ghafoorur Raheem
en: And if they had had patience till thou camest forth unto them, it had been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍۢ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ
tr: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo in jaaa'akum faasqum binaba in fatabaiyanooo an tuseeboo qawmam bijahalatin fatusbihoo 'alaa maa fa'altum naadimeen
en: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.

ar: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
tr: Wa'lamooo anna feekum Rasoolal laah; law yutee'ukum fee kaseerim minal amrila'anittum wa laakinnal laaha habbaba ilaikumul eemaana wa zaiyanahoo fee quloobikum wa karraha ilaikumul kufra walfusooqa wal'isyaan; ulaaaika humur raashidoon
en: And know that the messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in much of the government, ye would surely be in trouble; but Allah hath endeared the faith to you and hath beautified it in your hearts, and hath made disbelief and lewdness and rebellion hateful unto you. Such are they who are the rightly guided.

ar: فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
tr: Fadlam minal laahi wa ni'mah; wallaahu 'Aleemun Hakeem
en: (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise.

ar: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
tr: Wa in taaa'ifataani minal mu'mineenaq tataloo faaslihoo bainahumaa fa-im baghat ih daahumaa 'alal ukhraa faqaatilul latee tabhee hattaa tafeee'a ilaaa amril laah; fa-in faaa't fa aslihoo bainahumaa bil'adli wa aqsitoo innal laaha yuhibbul muqsiteen
en: And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.

ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌۭ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
tr: Innamal mu'minoona ikhwatun fa aslihoo baina akhawaykum wattaqul laaha la'allakum tuhamoon
en: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌۭ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
tr: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa yaskhar qawmum min qawmin 'asaaa anyyakoonoo khairam minhum wa laa nisaaa'um min nisaaa'in 'Asaaa ay yakunna khairam minhunna wa laa talmizooo bil alqaab; bi'sal ismul fusooqu ba'dal eemaan; wa mal-lam yatub fa-ulaaa'ika humuz zaalimoon
en: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌۭ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًۭا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
tr: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanuj taniboo kaseeram minaz zanni inna ba'daz zanniismunw wa laa tajassasoo wa la yaghtab ba'dukum ba'daa; a yuhibbu ahadukum any yaakula lahma akheehi maitan fakarih tumooh; wattaqul laa; innal laaha tawwaabur Raheem
en: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍۢ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ شُعُوبًۭا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۭ
tr: Yaaa ayyuhan naasu innaa khalaqnaakum min zakarinw wa unsaa wa ja'alnaakum shu'oobanw wa qabaaa'ila lita'aarafoo inna akramakum 'indal laahi atqaakum innal laaha 'Aleemun khabeer
en: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.

ar: ۞ قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
tr: Qaalatil-A 'raabu aamannaa qul lam tu'minoo wa laakin qoolooo aslamnaa wa lamma yadkhulil eemaanu fee quloobikum wa in tutee'ul laaha wa Rasoolahoo laa yalitkum min a'maalikum shai'aa; innal laaha Ghafoorur Raheem
en: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
tr: Innamal muu'minoonal lazeena aamanoo billaahi wa Rasoolihee summa lam yartaaboo wa jaahadoo biamwaalihim wa anfusihim fee sabeelil laah; ulaaaika humus saadiqoon
en: The (true) believers are those only who believe in Allah and His messenger and afterward doubt not, but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Such are the sincere.

ar: قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
tr: Qul atu'allimoonal laaha bideenikum wallaahu ya'lamu maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ard; wallaahu bikulli shai'in 'Aleem
en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things?

ar: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَٰمَكُم ۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
tr: Yamunnoona 'alaika an aslamoo qul laa tamunnoo 'alaiya Islaamakum balillaahu yamunnu 'alaikum an hadaakum lil eemaani in kuntum saadiqeen
en: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Innal laaha ya'lamu ghaibas samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu baseerum bimaa ta'maloon
en: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.

ar: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
tr: Qaaaf; wal Qur aanil Majeed
en: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,

ar: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
tr: Bal 'ajibooo an jaa'ahum munzirum minhum faqaalal kaafiroona haazaa shai'un 'ajeeb
en: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:

ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ
tr: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaaban zaalika raj'um ba'eed
en: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!

ar: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
tr: Qad 'alimnaa maa tanqu-sul-ardu minhum wa 'indanaa Kitaabun Hafeez
en: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.

ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ
tr: Bal kazzaboo bilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum fahum feee amrim mareej
en: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.

ar: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ
tr: Afalam yanzurooo ilas samaaa'i fawqahum kaifa banainaahaa wa zaiyannaahaa wa maa lahaa min furooj
en: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
tr: Wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej
en: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,

ar: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
tr: Tabsiratanw wa zikraa likulli 'abdim muneeb
en: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.

ar: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
tr: Wa nazzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am mubaarakan fa ambatnaa bihee jannaatinw wa habbal haseed
en: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,

ar: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
tr: Wannakhla baasiqaatil laha tal'un nadeed
en: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,

ar: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
tr: Rizqal lil'ibaad, wa ahyainaa bihee baldatam maitaa; kazaalikal khurooj
en: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
tr: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw wa Ashaabur Rassi wa Samood
en: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,

ar: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ
tr: Wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu wikhwaanu loot
en: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,

ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
tr: Wa Ashaabul Aykati wa qawmu Tubba'; kullun kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa wa'eed
en: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.

ar: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
tr: Afa'a yeenaa bilkhalqil awwal; bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed
en: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
tr: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana wa na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuhoo wa Nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min hablil wareed
en: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

ar: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
tr: 'Iz yatalaqqal mutalaqqi yaani 'anil yameeni wa 'anish shimaali qa'eed
en: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,

ar: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
tr: Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladaihi raqeebun 'ateed
en: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.

ar: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
tr: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu
en: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.

ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
tr: Wa nufikha fis Soor; zaalika yawmul wa'eed
en: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.

ar: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
tr: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed
en: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.

ar: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
tr: Laqad kunta fee ghaf latim min haazaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaaa'aka fabasarukal yawma hadeed
en: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.

ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
tr: Wa qaala qareenuhoo haazaa maa ladaiya 'ateed
en: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).

ar: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
tr: Alqiyaa fee Jahannama kulla kaffaarin 'aneed
en: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,

ar: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
tr: Mannaa'il lilkhayri mu'tadim mureeb
en: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,

ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
tr: Allazee ja'ala ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fa alqiyaahu fil'azaabish shadeed
en: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.

ar: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
tr: Qaala qareenuhoo Rabbanaa maaa atghaituhoo wa laakin kaana fee dalaahim ba'eed
en: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.

ar: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
tr: Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladaayya wa qad qaddamtu ilaikum bilwa'eed
en: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.

ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
tr: Maa yubaddalul qawlu ladaiya wa maaa ana bizal laamil lil'abeed
en: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.

ar: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
tr: Yawma naqoolu li'jahannama halim talaati wa taqoolu hal mim mazeed
en: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?

ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
tr: Wa uzlifatil jannatu lil muttaqeena ghaira ba'eed
en: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.

ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
tr: Haaza maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez
en: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,

ar: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
tr: Man khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaibi wa jaaa'a biqalbim muneeb
en: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.

ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
tr: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin zaalika yawmul khulood
en: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.

ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
tr: Lahum maa yashaaa'oona feehaa wa ladainaa mazeed
en: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.

ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
tr: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil bilaad, hal mim mahees
en: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
tr: Inna fee zaalika lazikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas sam'a wa huwa shaheed
en: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
tr: Wa laqad khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin wa maa massanaa mil lughoob
en: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.

ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
tr: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi wa qablal ghuroob
en: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
tr: Wa minal laili fasabbih hu wa adbaaras sujood
en: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.

ar: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
tr: Wastami' yawma yunaa dil munaadi mim makaanin qareeb
en: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,

ar: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
tr: Yawma yasmaoonas sai hata bilhaqq zaalika yawmul khurooj
en: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
tr: Innaa Nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa ilainal maseer
en: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.

ar: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
tr: Yawma tashaqqaqul ardu 'anhum siraa'aa; zaalika hashrun 'alainaa yaseer
en: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).

ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
tr: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wa maaa anta 'alihim bijabbaarin fazakkir bil quraani many yakhaafu wa'eed
en: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.

ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
tr: Waz-zaariyaati zarwaa
en: By those that winnow with a winnowing

ar: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
tr: Falhaamilaati wiqraa
en: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

ar: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
tr: Faljaariyaati yusraa
en: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
tr: Falmuqassimaati amraa
en: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,

ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
tr: Innamaa too'adoona la-saadiq
en: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,

ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
tr: Wa innad deena la waaqi'
en: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
tr: Wassamaaa'i zaatil hubuk
en: By the heaven full of paths,

ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
tr: Innakum lafee qawlim mukhtalif
en: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).

ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
tr: Yu'faku 'anhu man ufik
en: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.

ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
tr: Qutilal kharraasoon
en: Accursed be the conjecturers

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
tr: Allazeena hum fee ghamratin saahoon
en: Who are careless in an abyss!

ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
tr: Yas'aloona ayyaana yawmud Deen
en: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?

ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
tr: Yawma hum 'alan naari yuftanoon
en: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,

ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
tr: Zooqoo fitnatakum haa zal lazee kuntum bihee tas ta'jiloon
en: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
tr: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
en: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,

ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
tr: Aakhizeena maaa aataahum Rabbuhum; innahum kaanoo qabla zaalika muhsineen
en: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;

ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
tr: kaanoo qaleelam minal laili maa yahja'oon
en: They used to sleep but little of the night,

ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
tr: Wa bilashaari hum yastaghfiroon
en: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,

ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
tr: Wa feee amwaalihim haqqul lissaaa'ili walmahroom
en: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.

ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
tr: Wa fil ardi aayaatul lilmooqineen
en: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.

ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
tr: Wa feee anfusikum; afalaa tubsiroon
en: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?

ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
tr: Wa fissamaaa'i rizqukum wa maa too'adoon
en: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;

ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
tr: Fawa Rabbis samaaa'i wal ardi innahoo lahaqqum misla maa annakum tantiqoon
en: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
tr: Hal ataaka hadeesu daifi Ibraaheemal mukrameen
en: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?

ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
tr: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmum munkaroon
en: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).

ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
tr: Faraagha ilaaa ahlihee fajaaa'a bi'ijlin sameen
en: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;

ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
tr: Faqarrabahooo ilaihim qaala alaa taakuloon
en: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?

ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
tr: Fa awjasa minhm khee fatan qaaloo laa takhaf wa bashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem
en: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.

ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
tr: Fa aqbalatim ra-atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa wa qaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem
en: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!

ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
tr: Qaaloo kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki innahoo huwal hakeemul 'aleem
en: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.

ar: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
tr: Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal mursaloon
en: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
tr: Qaalooo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen
en: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,

ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
tr: Linursila 'alaihim hijaa ratam min teen
en: That we may send upon them stones of clay,

ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
tr: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika lilmusrifeen
en: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.

ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Fa akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal mu'mineen
en: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.

ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
tr: Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghaira baitim minal muslimeen
en: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).

ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
tr: Wa taraknaa feehaaa aayatal lillazeena yakhaafoonal 'azaabal aleem
en: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.

ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
tr: Wa fee Moosaaa iz arsalnaahu ilaa Fir'wna bisultaa nim mubeen
en: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,

ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
tr: Fatawalla biruknihee wa qaala saahirun aw majnoon
en: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.

ar: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
tr: Fa akhaznaahu wa junoo dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi wa huwa muleem
en: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.

ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
tr: Wa fee 'Aadin iz arsalnaa 'alaihimur reehal'aqeem
en: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.

ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
tr: Maa tazaru min shai'in atat 'alaihi illaa ja'alat hu karrameem
en: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.

ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
tr: Wa fee Samooda iz qeela lahum tamatta''oo hattaa heen
en: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.

ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
tr: Fa'ataw 'an amri Rabbihim fa akhazal humus saa'iqatu wa hum yanzuroon
en: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;

ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
tr: Famas tataa'oo min qiyaaminw wa maa kaanoo muntasireen
en: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.

ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
tr: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaano qawman faasiqeen
en: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
tr: Wassamaaa'a banainaa haa bi aydinw wa innaa lamoosi'oon
en: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
tr: Wal arda farashnaahaa fani'mal maahidoon
en: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!

ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
tr: Wa min kulli shai'in khalaqnaa zawjaini la'allakum tazakkaroon
en: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.

ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
tr: Fafirrooo ilal laahi innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen
en: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.

ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
tr: Wa laa taj'aloo ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen
en: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
tr: Kazaalika maaa atal lazeena min qablihim mir Rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon
en: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!

ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
tr: Atawaasaw bih; bal hum qawmun taaghoon
en: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.

ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
tr: Fatawalla 'anhum famaaa anta bimaloom
en: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,

ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
tr: Wa zakkir fa innaz zikraa tanfa'ul mu'mineen
en: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
tr: Wa maa khalaqtul jinna wal insa illaa liya'budoon
en: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.

ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
tr: Maaa ureedu minhum mir rizqinw wa maaa ureedu anyyut'imoon
en: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
tr: Innal laaha Huwar Razzaaqu Zul Quwwatil Mateen
en: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.

ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
tr: Fa inna lillazeena zalamoo zanoobam misla zanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon
en: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).

ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
tr: Fawailul lillazeena kafaroo miny yawmihimul lazee yoo'adoon
en: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.

ar: وَٱلطُّورِ
tr: Wat-Toor
en: By the Mount,

ar: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
tr: Wa kitaabim mastoor
en: And a Scripture inscribed

ar: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
tr: Fee raqqim manshoor
en: On fine parchment unrolled,

ar: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
tr: Wal baitil ma'moor
en: And the House frequented,

ar: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
tr: Wassaqfil marfoo'
en: And the roof exalted,

ar: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
tr: Wal bahril masjoor
en: And the sea kept filled,

ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
tr: Inna 'azaaba Rabbika lawaaqi'
en: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;

ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
tr: Maa lahoo min daafi'
en: There is none that can ward it off.

ar: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
tr: Yawma tamoorus samaaa'u mawraa
en: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,

ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
tr: Wa taseerul jibaalu sairaa
en: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,

ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Fawailuny yawma 'izil lil mukaazzibeen
en: Then woe that day unto the deniers

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
tr: Allazeena hum fee khawdiny yal'aboon
en: Who play in talk of grave matters;

ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
tr: Yawma yuda'-'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'-'aa
en: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell

ar: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
tr: Haazihin naarul latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon
en: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.

ar: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
tr: Afasihrun haazaaaa am antum laa tubsiroon
en: Is this magic, or do ye not see?

ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Islawhaa fasbirooo aw laa tasbiroo sawaaa'un 'alaikum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
en: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
tr: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa na'eem
en: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,

ar: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
tr: Faakiheena bimaaa aataahum rabbuhum wa waqaahum rabbuhum 'azaabal jaheem
en: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.

ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
en: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,

ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
tr: Muttaki'eena 'alaa sururim masfoofatinw wa zawwaj naahum bihoorin 'een
en: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
tr: Wallazeena aamanoo wattaba'at hum zurriyyatuhum bieemaanin alhaqnaa bihim zurriyyatahum wa maaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shai'; kullum ri'im bimaa kasaba raheen
en: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.

ar: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
tr: Wa amdadnaahum bifaa kihatinw wa lahmim mimmaa yashtahoon
en: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

ar: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
tr: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa kaasal laa laghwun feehaa wa laa taaseem
en: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.

ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
tr: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim ghilmaanul lahum ka annahum lu'lu'um maknoon
en: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.

ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
tr: Wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon
en: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
tr: Qaalooo innaa kunnaa qablu feee ahlinaa mushfiqeen
en: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;

ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
tr: Famannnal laahu 'alainaa wa waqaanaa 'azaabas samoom
en: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.

ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal barrur raheem
en: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.

ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
tr: Fazakkir famaaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahininw wa laa majnoon
en: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
tr: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon
en: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?

ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
tr: Qul tarabbasoo fa innee ma'akum minal mutarabbiseen
en: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.

ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
tr: Am taamuruhum ahlaamuhum bihaazaaa am hum qawmun taaghoon
en: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
tr: Am yaqooloona taqawwalah; bal laa yu'minoon
en: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!

ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
tr: Falyaatoo bihadeesim misliheee in kaanoo saadiqeen
en: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.

ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
tr: Am khuliqoo min ghairi shai'in am humul khaaliqoon
en: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?

ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
tr: Am khalaqus samaawaati wal ard; bal laa yooqinoon
en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!

ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
tr: Am'indahum khazaaa'inu rabbika am humul musaitiroon
en: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
tr: Am lahum sullamuny yastami'oona feehi falyaati mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen
en: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!

ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
tr: Am lahul banaatu wa lakumul banoon
en: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?

ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
tr: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon
en: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?

ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
tr: Am 'indahumul ghaibu fahum yaktuboon
en: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?

ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
tr: Am yureedoona kaidan fallazeena kafaroo humul makeedoon
en: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
tr: Am lahum ilaahun ghairul laa; subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon
en: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!

ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
tr: Wa iny yaraw kisfam minas samaaa'i saaqitany yaqooloo sahaabum markoom
en: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.

ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
tr: Fazarhum hatta yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee feehi yus'aqoon
en: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,

ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
tr: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kaidumhum shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon
en: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.

ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
tr: Wa inna lillazeena zalamoo 'azaaban doona zalika wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
en: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.

ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
tr: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa innaka bi-a'yuninaa wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom
en: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
tr: Wa minal laili fasabbihhu wa idbaaran nujoom
en: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.

ar: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
tr: Wannajmi izaa hawaa
en: By the Star when it setteth,

ar: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
tr: Maa dalla saahibukum wa maa ghawaa
en: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;

ar: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
tr: Wa maa yyantiqu 'anilhawaaa
en: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ
tr: In huwa illaa Wahyuny yoohaa
en: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,

ar: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
tr: 'Allamahoo shadeedul quwaa
en: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,

ar: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
tr: Zoo mirratin fastawaa
en: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view

ar: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
tr: Wa huwa bil ufuqil a'laa
en: When he was on the uppermost horizon.

ar: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
tr: Summa danaa fatadalla
en: Then he drew nigh and came down

ar: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
tr: Fakaana qaaba qawsaini aw adnaa
en: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,

ar: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
tr: Fa awhaaa ilaa 'abdihee maaa awhaa
en: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.

ar: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
tr: Maa kazabal fu'aadu maa ra aa
en: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.

ar: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
tr: Afatumaaroonahoo 'alaa maayaraa
en: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?

ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
tr: Wa laqad ra aahu nazlatan ukhraa
en: And verily he saw him yet another time

ar: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
tr: 'Inda sidratil muntaha
en: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,

ar: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
tr: 'Indahaa jannatul maawaa
en: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.

ar: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
tr: Iz yaghshas sidrata maa yaghshaa
en: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,

ar: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
tr: Maa zaaghal basaru wa maa taghaa
en: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.

ar: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
tr: Laqad ra aa min aayaati Rabbihil kubraaa
en: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.

ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
tr: Afara'aytumul laata wal 'uzzaa
en: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza

ar: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
tr: Wa manaatas saalisatal ukhraa
en: And Manat, the third, the other?

ar: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
tr: A-lakumuz zakaru wa lahul unsaa
en: Are yours the males and His the females?

ar: تِلْكَ إِذًۭا قِسْمَةٌۭ ضِيزَىٰٓ
tr: Tilka izan qismatun deezaa
en: That indeed were an unfair division!

ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
tr: In hiya illaaa asmaaa'un sammaitumoohaaa antum wa aabaaa'ukum maaa anzalal laahu bihaa min sultaan; inyyattabi'oona illaz zanna wa maa tahwal anfusu wa laqad jaaa'ahum mir Rabbihimul hudaa
en: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.

ar: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
tr: Am lil insaani maa taman naa
en: Or shall man have what he coveteth?

ar: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
tr: Falillaahil aakhiratu wal oolaa
en: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.

ar: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
tr: Wa kam mim malakin fissamaawaati laa tughnee shafaa'atuhum shai'an illaa mim ba'di anyyaazanal laahu limany yashaaa'u wa yardaa
en: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
tr: innal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati la yusammoonal malaaa'ikata tasmiyatal unsaa
en: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.

ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا
tr: Wa maa lahum bihee min 'ilmin iny yattabi'oona illaz zanna wa innaz zanna laa yughnee minal haqqi shai'aa
en: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.

ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
tr: Fa a'rid 'am man tawallaa 'an zikrinaa wa lam yurid illal hayaatad dunyaa
en: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.

ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
tr: Zalika mablaghuhum minal 'ilm; inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabee lihee wa huwa a'lamu bimanih tadaa
en: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.

ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
tr: Wa lillaahi maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi liyajziyal lazeena asaaa'oo bimaa 'amiloo wa yajziyal lazeena ahsanoo bilhusnaa
en: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
tr: Allazeena yajtaniboona kabaaa'iral ismi walfawaa hisha illal lamam; inna rabbaka waasi'ul maghfirah; huwa a'lamu bikum iz ansha akum minal ardi wa iz antum ajinnatun fee butooni umma haatikum falaa tuzakkooo anfusakum huwa a'lamu bimanit taqaa
en: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).

ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
tr: Afara'ayatal lazee tawallaa
en: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,

ar: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًۭا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
tr: Wa a'taa qaleelanw wa akdaa
en: And gave a little, then was grudging?

ar: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
tr: A'indahoo 'ilmul ghaibi fahuwa yaraa
en: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?

ar: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
tr: Am lam yunabbaa bimaa fee suhuhfi Moosa
en: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses

ar: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
tr: Wa Ibraaheemal lazee waffaaa
en: And Abraham who paid his debt:

ar: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
tr: Allaa taziru waaziratunw wizra ukhraa
en: That no laden one shall bear another's load,

ar: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
tr: Wa al laisa lil insaani illaa maa sa'aa
en: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,

ar: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
tr: Wa anna sa'yahoo sawfa yuraa
en: And that his effort will be seen.

ar: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
tr: Summa yujzaahul jazaaa 'al awfaa
en: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;

ar: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
tr: Wa anna ilaa rabbikal muntahaa
en: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
tr: Wa annahoo huwa adhaka wa abkaa
en: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
tr: Wa annahoo huwa amaata wa ahyaa
en: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
tr: Wa annahoo khalaqaz zawjainiz zakara wal unsaa
en: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,

ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
tr: Min nutfatin izaa tumnaa
en: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;

ar: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
tr: Wa anna 'alaihin nash atal ukhraa
en: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
tr: Wa annahoo huwa aghnaa wa aqnaa
en: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
tr: Wa annahoo huwa rabbush shi'raa
en: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
tr: Wa annahooo ahlak a 'Aadanil oolaa
en: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,

ar: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
tr: Wa samooda famaaa abqaa
en: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;

ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
tr: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaanoo hum azlama wa atghaa
en: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;

ar: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
tr: Wal mu'tafikata ahwaa
en: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed

ar: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
tr: Faghashshaahaa maa ghashshaa
en: So that there covered them that which did cover.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbika tatamaaraa
en: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?

ar: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
tr: Haazaa nazeerum minan nuzuril oolaa
en: This is a warner of the warners of old.

ar: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْءَازِفَةُ
tr: Azifatil laazifah
en: The threatened Hour is nigh.

ar: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
tr: Laisa lahaa min doonil laahi kaashifah
en: None beside Allah can disclose it.

ar: أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
tr: Afamin hazal hadeesi ta'jaboon
en: Marvel ye then at this statement,

ar: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
tr: Wa tadhakoona wa laa tabkoon
en: And laugh and not weep,

ar: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ
tr: Wa antum saamidoon
en: While ye amuse yourselves?

ar: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
tr: Fasjudoo lillaahi wa'budoo
en: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.

ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
tr: Iqtarabatis Saa'atu wsan shaqqal qamar
en: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.

ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
tr: Wa iny yaraw aayatany yu'ridoo wa yaqooloo sihrum mustamirr
en: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.

ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
tr: Wa kazzaboo wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum; wa kullu amrim mustaqirr
en: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
tr: Wa laqad jaaa'ahum minal ambaaa'i maa feehi muzdajar
en: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,

ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
tr: Hikmatum baalighatun famaa tughnin nuzur
en: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.

ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
tr: Fatawalla 'anhum; yawma yad'ud daa'i ilaa shai 'in nukur
en: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.

ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
tr: khushsha'an absaaruhum yakrujoona minal ajdaasi ka annahum jaraadum muntashir
en: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,

ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
tr: Muhti'eena ilad daa'i yaqoolul kafiroona haazaa yawmun 'asir
en: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.

ar: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
tr: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohin fakazzaboo 'abdanaa wa qaaloo majnoo nunw wazdujir
en: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.

ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
tr: Fada'aa Rabbahooo annee maghloobun fantasir
en: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.

ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
tr: Fafatahnaaa abwaabas sa maaa'i bimaa'im munhamir
en: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
tr: Wa fajjamal arda 'uyoonan faltaqal maaa'u 'alaaa amrin qad qudir
en: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.

ar: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
tr: Wa hamalnaahu 'alaa zaati alwaahinw wa dusur
en: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,

ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
tr: Tajree bi a'yuninaa jazaaa 'al liman kaana kufir
en: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.

ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
tr: Wa laqat taraknaahaad aayatan fahal mim muddakir
en: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
tr: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
en: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
tr: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mimmuddakir
en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
tr: Kazzabat 'Aadun fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
en: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
tr: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran fee Yawmi nahsim mustamirr
en: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,

ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
tr: Tanzi;un naasa ka anna huma'jaazu nakhlim munqa'ir
en: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
tr: 'Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
en: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
tr: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir
en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
tr: Kazzabat Samoodu binnuzur
en: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings

ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
tr: Faqaalooo a-basharam minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhooo innaa izal lafee dalaalinw wa su'ur
en: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.

ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
tr: 'A-ulqiyaz zikru 'alaihi mim baininaa bal huwa kazzaabun ashir
en: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.

ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
tr: Sa-ya'lamoona ghadam manil kazzaabul ashir
en: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.

ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
tr: Innaa mursilun naaqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum wastabir
en: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;

ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
tr: Wa nabbi'hum annal maaa'a qismatum bainahum kullu shirbim muhtadar
en: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.

ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
tr: Fanaadaw saahibahum fata'aataa fa'aqar
en: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
tr: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
en: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
tr: Innaaa arsalnaa 'alaihim saihatanw waahidatan fakaano kahasheemil muhtazir
en: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
tr: Wa laqad yassarnal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir
en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
tr: Kazzabat qawmu lootim binnuzur
en: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
tr: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim haasiban illaaa aala Loot najjainaahum bisahar
en: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,

ar: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
tr: Ni'matam min 'indinaa; kazaalika najzee man shakar
en: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
tr: Wa laqad anzarahum batshatanaa fatamaaraw binnuzur
en: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.

ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
tr: Wa laqad raawadoohu 'andaifee fatamasnaaa a'yunahum fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur
en: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!

ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
tr: Wa laqad sabbahahum bukratan 'azaabum mustaqirr
en: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.

ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
tr: Fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur
en: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
tr: Wa laqad yassarnal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir
en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
tr: Wa laqad jaaa'a Aala Fir'awnan nuzur
en: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
tr: Kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa kullihaa fa akhaznaahum akhza 'azeezim muqtadir
en: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.

ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
tr: Akuffaarukum khairum min ulaaa'ikum am lakum baraaa'atun fiz Zubur
en: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
tr: Am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'um muntasir
en: Or say they: We are a host victorious?

ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
tr: Sa yuhzamul jam'u wa yuwalloonad dubur
en: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.

ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
tr: Balis Saa'atu maw'iduhum was Saa'atu adhaa wa amarr
en: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
tr: Innal mujrimeena fee dalaalinw wa su'ur
en: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.

ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
tr: Yawma yushaboona fin Naari'alaa wujoohimim zooqoo massa saqar
en: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.

ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
tr: Innaa kulla shai'in khalaqnaahu biqadar
en: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.

ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
tr: Wa maaa amrunaaa illaa waahidatun kalamhim bilbasar
en: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
tr: Wa laqad ahlaknaaa ashyaa'akum fahal mim muddakir
en: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?

ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
tr: Wa kullu shai'in fa'aloohu fiz Zubur
en: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,

ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
tr: Wa kullu sagheerinw wa kabeerim mustatar
en: And every small and great thing is recorded.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
tr: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa nahar
en: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,

ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
tr: Fee maq'adi sidqin 'inda Maleekim Muqtadir
en: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.

ar: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
tr: Ar Rahmaan
en: The Beneficent

ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
tr: 'Allamal Quran
en: Hath made known the Qur'an.

ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
tr: Khalaqal insaan
en: He hath created man.

ar: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
tr: 'Allamalhul bayaan
en: He hath taught him utterance.

ar: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ
tr: Ashshamsu walqamaru bihusbaan
en: The sun and the moon are made punctual.

ar: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
tr: Wannajmu washshajaru yasjudan
en: The stars and the trees prostrate.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
tr: Wassamaaa'a rafa'ahaa wa wada'al Meezan
en: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,

ar: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
tr: Allaa tatghaw fil meezaan
en: That ye exceed not the measure,

ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
tr: Wa aqeemul wazna bilqisti wa laa tukhsirul meezaan
en: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
tr: Wal arda wada'ahaa lilanaame
en: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,

ar: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
tr: Feehaa faakihatunw wan nakhlu zaatul akmaam
en: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,

ar: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
tr: Walhabbu zul 'asfi war Raihaanu
en: Husked grain and scented herb.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
tr: Khalaqal insaana min salsaalin kalfakhkhaari
en: He created man of clay like the potter's,

ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
tr: Wa khalaqal jaaan mim maarijim min naar
en: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
tr: Rabbul mashriqayni wa Rabbul maghribayni
en: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
tr: Marajal bahrayni yalta qiyaani
en: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.

ar: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
tr: Bainahumaa barzakhul laa yabghiyaan
en: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
tr: Yakhruju minhumal lu 'lu u wal marjaanu
en: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
tr: Wa lahul jawaaril mun sha'aatu fil bahri kal a'laam
en: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ
tr: Kullu man 'alaihaa faan
en: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;

ar: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
tr: Wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal ikraam
en: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
tr: Yas'aluhoo man fissamaawaati walard; kulla ywmin huwa fee shaan
en: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
tr: Sanafrughu lakum ayyuhas saqalaan
en: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
tr: Yaa ma'sharal jinni wal insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan
en: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
tr: Yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarifiw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan
en: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
tr: Fa-izan shaqqatis samaaa'u fakaanat wardatan kaddihaan
en: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -

ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
tr: Fa-yawma'izil laa yus'alu 'an zambiheee insunw wa laa jaann
en: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
tr: Yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna waasi wal aqdaam
en: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
tr: Haazihee jahannamul latee yukazzibu bihal mujrimoon
en: This is hell which the guilty deny.

ar: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍۢ
tr: Yatoofoona bainahaa wa baina hameemim aan
en: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
tr: Wa liman khaafa maqaama rabbihee jannataan
en: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍۢ
tr: Zawaataaa afnaan
en: Of spreading branches.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
tr: Feehimaa 'aynaani tajriyaan
en: Wherein are two fountains flowing.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍۢ زَوْجَانِ
tr: Feehimaa min kulli faakihatin zawjaan
en: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
tr: Muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq; wajanal jannataini daan
en: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
tr: Feehinna qaasiratut tarfi lam yatmishunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann
en: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
tr: ka annahunnal yaaqootu wal marjaan
en: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
tr: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

ar: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ
tr: Hal jazaaa'ul ihsaani illal ihsaan
en: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
