ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
tr: Fakaifa tattaqoona in kafartum yawmany yaj'alul wildaana sheeba
en: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,

ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
tr: Assamaaa'u munfatirum bih; kaana wa'duhoo maf'oola
en: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
tr: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa Rabbihee sabeelaa
en: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.

ar: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
tr: Inna Rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min sulusa yil laili wa nisfahoo wa sulusahoo wa taaa'ifatum minal lazeena ma'ak; wal laahu yuqaddirul laila wanna haar; 'alima al lan tuhsoohu fataaba 'alaikum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal quraan; 'alima an sa yakoonu minkum mardaa wa aakharoona yadriboona fil ardi yabtaghoona min fadlil laahi wa aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelil laahi faqra'oo ma tayassara minhu wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaata wa aqridul laaha qardan hasanaa; wa maa tuqadimoo li anfusikum min khairin tajidoohu 'indal laahi huwa khayranw wa a'zama ajraa; wastaghfirul laahaa innal laaha ghafoorur raheem.
en: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
tr: Yaaa ayyuhal muddassir
en: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,

ar: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
tr: Qum fa anzir
en: Arise and warn!

ar: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
tr: Wa rabbaka fakabbir
en: Thy Lord magnify,

ar: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
tr: Wa siyaabaka fatahhir
en: Thy raiment purify,

ar: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
tr: Warrujza fahjur
en: Pollution shun!

ar: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
tr: Wa laa tamnun tastaksir
en: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!

ar: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
tr: Wa li Rabbika fasbir
en: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!

ar: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
tr: Fa izaa nuqira fin naaqoor
en: For when the trumpet shall sound,

ar: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
tr: Fazaalika yawma 'iziny yawmun 'aseer
en: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,

ar: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ
tr: 'Alal kaafireena ghayru yaseer
en: Not of ease, for disbelievers.

ar: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا
tr: Zamee wa man khalaqtu waheedaa
en: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,

ar: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا
tr: Wa ja'altu lahoo maalam mamdoodaa
en: And then bestowed upon him ample means,

ar: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا
tr: Wa baneena shuhoodaa
en: And sons abiding in his presence

ar: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا
tr: Wa mahhattu lahoo tamheeda
en: And made (life) smooth for him.

ar: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
tr: Summa yat ma'u an azeed
en: Yet he desireth that I should give more.

ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا
tr: Kallaaa innahoo kaana li Aayaatinaa 'aneedaa
en: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.

ar: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
tr: Sa urhiquhoo sa'oodaa
en: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
tr: Innahoo fakkara wa qaddar
en: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -

ar: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
tr: Faqutila kayfa qaddar
en: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!

ar: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
tr: Summa qutila kaifa qaddar
en: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -

ar: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
tr: Summa nazar
en: Then looked he,

ar: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
tr: Summa 'abasa wa basar
en: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.

ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
tr: Summaa adbara wastakbar
en: Then turned he away in pride

ar: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
tr: Faqaala in haazaaa illaa sihruny yu'sar
en: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;

ar: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
tr: In haazaaa illaa qawlul bashar
en: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.

ar: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
tr: Sa usleehi saqar
en: Him shall I fling unto the burning.

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
tr: Wa maaa adraaka maa saqar
en: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -

ar: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
tr: Laa tubqee wa laa tazar
en: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught

ar: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ
tr: Lawwaahatul lilbashar
en: It shrivelleth the man.

ar: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
tr: 'Alaihaa tis'ata 'ashar
en: Above it are nineteen.

ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
tr: Wa maaja''alnaaa As haaban naari illaa malaaa 'ikatanw wa maa ja'alnaa 'iddatahum illaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo liyastayqinal lazeena ootul kitaaba wa yazdaadal lazeena aamanooo eemaananw wa laa yartaabal lazeena ootul kitaaba walmu'minoona wa liyaqoolal lazeena fee quloo bihim maradunw walkaafiroona maazaaa araadal laahu bihaazaa masalaa; kazaalika yudillul laahu many yashaaa'u wa yahdee many yashaaa'; wa maa ya'lamu junooda rabbika illaa hoo; wa maa hiya illaa zikraa lil bashar
en: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.

ar: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
tr: Kallaa walqamar
en: Nay, by the Moon

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
tr: Wallaili adbar
en: And the night when it withdraweth

ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
tr: Wassub hi izaaa asfar
en: And the dawn when it shineth forth,

ar: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
tr: Innahaa la ihdal kubar
en: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)

ar: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ
tr: Nazeeral lilbashar
en: As a warning unto men,

ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
tr: Liman shaaa'a minkum any yataqaddama aw yata akhkhar
en: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.

ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
tr: Kullu nafsim bim kasabat raheenah
en: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;

ar: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
tr: Illaaa as haabal yameen
en: Save those who will stand on the right hand.

ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
tr: Fee jannaatiny yata saaa'aloon
en: In gardens they will ask one another

ar: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
tr: 'Anil mujrimeen
en: Concerning the guilty:

ar: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
tr: Maa salakakum fee saqar
en: What hath brought you to this burning?

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
tr: Qaaloo lam naku minal musalleen
en: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed

ar: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
tr: Wa lam naku nut'imul miskeen
en: Nor did we feed the wretched.

ar: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
tr: Wa kunnaa nakhoodu ma'al khaaa'ideen
en: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,

ar: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
tr: Wa kunnaa nukazzibu bi yawmid Deen
en: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
tr: Hattaaa ataanal yaqeen
en: Till the Inevitable came unto us.

ar: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
tr: Famaa tanfa'uhum shafaa'atush shaafi'een
en: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.

ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
tr: Famaa lahum 'anittazkirati mu'rideen
en: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,

ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ
tr: Ka annahum humurum mustanfirah
en: As they were frightened asses

ar: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
tr: Farrat min qaswarah
en: Fleeing from a lion?

ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
tr: Bal yureedu kullum ri'im minhum any yu'taa suhufam munashsharah
en: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).

ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
tr: Kallaa bal laa yakhaafoonal aakhirah
en: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
tr: Kallaaa innahoo tazkirah
en: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.

ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
tr: Fa man shaaa'a zakarah
en: So whosoever will may heed.

ar: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
tr: Wa maa yazkuroona illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; Huwa ahlut taqwaa wa ahlul maghfirah
en: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.

ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
tr: Laaa uqsimu bi yawmil qiyaamah
en: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;

ar: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
tr: Wa laaa uqsimu bin nafsil lawwaamah
en: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
tr: Ayahsabul insaanu al lan najm'a 'izaamah
en: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?

ar: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
tr: Balaa qaadireena 'alaaa an nusawwiya banaanah
en: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!

ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
tr: Bal yureedul insaanu liyafjura amaamah
en: But man would fain deny what is before him.

ar: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
tr: Yas'alu ayyyaana yawmul qiyaamah
en: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?

ar: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
tr: Fa izaa bariqal basar
en: But when sight is confounded

ar: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
tr: We khasafal qamar
en: And the moon is eclipsed

ar: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
tr: Wa jumi'ash shamusu wal qamar
en: And sun and moon are united,

ar: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
tr: Yaqoolul insaanu yaw ma 'izin aynal mafarr
en: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!

ar: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
tr: Kallaa laa wazar
en: Alas! No refuge!

ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
tr: Ilaa rabbika yawma 'izinil mustaqarr
en: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.

ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
tr: Yunabba 'ul insaanu yawma 'izim bimaa qaddama wa akhkhar
en: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.

ar: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ
tr: Balil insaanu 'alaa nafsihee baseerah
en: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,

ar: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
tr: Wa law alqaa ma'aazeerah
en: Although he tender his excuses.

ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
tr: Laa tuharrik bihee lisaa naka lita'jala bih
en: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.

ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
tr: Inna 'alainaa jam'ahoo wa qur aanah
en: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.

ar: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
tr: Fa izaa qaraanaahu fattabi' qur aanah
en: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
tr: Summa inna 'alainaa bayaanah
en: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.

ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
tr: Kallaa bal tuhibboonal 'aajilah
en: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now

ar: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
tr: Wa tazaroonal Aakhirah
en: And neglect the Hereafter.

ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ
tr: Wujoohuny yawma 'izin naadirah
en: That day will faces be resplendent,

ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ
tr: Ilaa rabbihaa naazirah
en: Looking toward their Lord;

ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ
tr: Wa wujoohuny yawma 'izim baasirah
en: And that day will other faces be despondent,

ar: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ
tr: Tazunnu any yuf'ala bihaa faaqirah
en: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.

ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
tr: Kallaaa izaa balaghatit taraaqee
en: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat

ar: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ
tr: Wa qeela man raaq
en: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?

ar: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
tr: Wa zanna annahul firaaq
en: And he knoweth that it is the parting;

ar: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
tr: Waltaffatis saaqu bissaaq
en: And agony is heaped on agony;

ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
tr: Ilaa rabbika yawma'izinil masaaq
en: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.

ar: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
tr: Falaa saddaqa wa laa sallaa
en: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.

ar: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
tr: Wa laakin kazzaba wa tawalla
en: But he denied and flouted.

ar: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
tr: Summa zahaba ilaaa ahlihee yatamatta
en: Then went he to his folk with glee.

ar: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
tr: Awlaa laka fa awlaa
en: Nearer unto thee and nearer,

ar: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
tr: Summa awlaa laka fa awla
en: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
tr: Ayahsabul insaanu anyytraka sudaa
en: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?

ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
tr: Alam yaku nutfatam mim maniyyiny yumnaa
en: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?

ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
tr: Summa kaana 'alaqata fakhalaq fasawwaa
en: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned

ar: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
tr: Faja'ala minhuz zawjayniz zakara wal unsaa
en: And made of him a pair, the male and female.

ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
tr: Alaisa zaalika biqaadirin 'alaaa any yuhyiyal mawtaa
en: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
tr: Hal ataa 'alal insaani heenum minad dahri lam yakun shai'am mazkooraa
en: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?

ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
tr: Innaa khalaqnal insaana min nutfatin amshaajin nabta leehi faja'alnaahu samee'am baseeraa
en: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.

ar: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
tr: Innaa hadainaahus sabeela immaa shaakiranw wa immaa kafoora
en: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.

ar: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
tr: Innaaa a'tadnaa lilkaa fireena salaasila wa aghlaalanw wa sa'eeraa
en: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
tr: innal abraara yashra boona min kaasin kaana mizaa juhaa kaafooraa
en: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,

ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
tr: 'Aynany yashrabu bihaa 'ibaadul laahi yafajjiroonahaa tafjeeraa
en: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,

ar: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
tr: Yoofoona binnazri wa yakhaafoona yawman kaana sharruhoo mustateeraa
en: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,

ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
tr: Wa yut''imoonat ta'aama 'alaa hubbihee miskeenanw wa yatemanw wa aseeraa
en: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,

ar: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
tr: Innaamaa nut'imukum li wajhil laahi laa nureedu minkum jazaaa'anw wa laa shukooraa
en: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;

ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
tr: Innaa nakhaafu mir Rabbinna Yawman 'aboosan qamtareeraa
en: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.

ar: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
tr: Fa waqaahumul laahu sharra zaalikal yawmi wa laqqaahum nadratanw wa surooraa
en: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;

ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
tr: Wa jazaahum bimaa sabaroo janatanw wa hareeraa
en: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;

ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
tr: muttaki'eena feeha 'alal araaa 'iki laa yarawna feehaa shamsanw wa laa zamhareeraa
en: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.

ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
tr: Wa daaniyatan 'alaihim zilaaluhaa wa zullilat qutoofu haa tazleela
en: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.

ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
tr: Wa yutaafu 'alaihim bi aaniyatim min fiddatinw wa akwaabin kaanat qawaareeraa
en: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

ar: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
tr: Qawaareera min fiddatin qaddaroohaa taqdeeraa
en: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).

ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
tr: Wa yusawna feehaa kaasan kaana mizaajuhaa zanjabeelaa
en: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,

ar: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
tr: 'Aynan feeha tusammaa salsabeelaa
en: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.

ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
tr: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim wildaanum mukhalladoona izaa ra aytahum hasibtahum lu'lu 'am mansoora
en: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.

ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
tr: Wa izaa ra ayta summa ra ayta na'eemanw wa mulkan kabeera
en: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.

ar: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
tr: 'Aaliyahum siyaabu sundusin khudrunw wa istabraq, wa hullooo asaawira min fiddatinw wa saqaahum Rabbuhum sharaaban tahooraa
en: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
tr: Innaa haazaa kaana lakum jazz 'anw wa kaana sa'yukum mashkooraa
en: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
tr: Innaa nahnu nazzalnaa 'alaikal quraana tanzeelaa
en: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;

ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
tr: Fasbir lihukmi Rabbika wa laa tuti' minhum aasiman aw kafooraa
en: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.

ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
tr: Wazkuris ma Rabbika bukratanw wa aseelaa
en: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
tr: Wa minal laili fasjud lahoo wa sabbihhu lailan taweelaa
en: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
tr: Inna haaa'ulaa'i yuhibboona 'aajilata wa yazaroona waraaa'ahum yawman saqeelaa
en: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.

ar: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
tr: Nahnu khalaqnaahum wa shadadnaaa asrahum wa izaa shi'naa baddalnaaa amsaala hum tabdeelaa
en: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
tr: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa rabbihee sabeela
en: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.

ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
tr: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaa anyyashaaa'al laah; innal laahaa kaana'Aleeman Hakeema
en: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

ar: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
tr: Yudkhilu mai yashaaa'u fee rahmatih; wazzaalimeena a'adda lahum 'azaaban aleemaa
en: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.

ar: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
tr: Wal mursalaati'urfaa
en: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another

ar: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًۭا
tr: Fal'aasifaati 'asfaa
en: By the raging hurricanes,

ar: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًۭا
tr: Wannaashiraati nashraa
en: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;

ar: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًۭا
tr: Falfaariqaati farqaa
en: By those who winnow with a winnowing,

ar: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
tr: Falmulqiyaati zikra
en: By those who bring down the Reminder,

ar: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
tr: 'Uzran aw nuzraa
en: To excuse or to warn,

ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
tr: Innamaa too'adoona lawaaqi'
en: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.

ar: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
tr: Fa izam nujoomu tumisat
en: So when the stars are put out,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
tr: Wa izas samaaa'u furijat
en: And when the sky is riven asunder,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
tr: Wa izal jibaalu nusifat
en: And when the mountains are blown away,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
tr: Wa izar Rusulu uqqitat
en: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -

ar: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
tr: Li ayyi yawmin ujjilat
en: For what day is the time appointed?

ar: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
tr: Li yawmil Fasl
en: For the Day of Decision.

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
tr: Wa maaa adraaka maa yawmul fasl
en: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailuny yawma 'izillilmukazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
tr: Alam nuhlikil awwaleen
en: Destroyed We not the former folk,

ar: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
tr: Summa nutbi'uhumul aakhireen
en: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
tr: Kazzlika naf'alu bilmujrimeen
en: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailunw yawma 'izil lil mukazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
tr: Alam nakhlukkum mimmaaa'im maheen
en: Did We not create you from a base fluid

ar: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ
tr: Faja'alnaahu fee qaraarim makeen
en: Which We laid up in a safe abode

ar: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
tr: Illaa qadrim ma'loom
en: For a known term?

ar: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
tr: Faqadarnaa fani'mal qaadiroon
en: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailuny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
tr: Alam naj'alil arda kifaataa
en: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

ar: أَحْيَآءًۭ وَأَمْوَٰتًۭا
tr: Ahyaaa'anw wa amwaataa
en: Both for the living and the dead,

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
tr: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa rawaasiya shaamikhaatinw wa asqainaakum maaa'an furaataa
en: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailuny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
tr: Intaliqooo ilaa maa kuntum bihee tukazziboon
en: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;

ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
tr: Intaliqooo ilaa zillin zee salaasi shu'ab
en: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,

ar: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
tr: Laa zaleelinw wa laa yughnee minal lahab
en: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.

ar: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
tr: Innahaa tarmee bishararin kalqasr
en: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,

ar: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ
tr: Ka annahoo jimaalatun sufr
en: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailuny yawma 'izil lilmukazibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
tr: Haazaa yawmu laa uantiqoon
en: This is a day wherein they speak not,

ar: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
tr: Wa laa yu'zanu lahum fa ya'taziroon
en: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailunw yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
tr: Haaza yawmul fasli jama 'naakum wal awwaleen
en: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.

ar: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ
tr: Fa in kaana lakum kaidun fakeedoon
en: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailuny yawma'izil lilmukazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
tr: Innal muttaqeena fee zilaalinw wa 'uyoon
en: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,

ar: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
tr: Wa fawaakiha mimmaa yastahoon
en: And fruits such as they desire.

ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
tr: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
en: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.

ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
tr: Innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen
en: Thus do We reward the good.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailuny yawma 'izil lilmuzkazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
tr: Kuloo wa tamatta'oo qaleelan innakum mujrimoon
en: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailunny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
tr: Wa izaa qeela lahumur ka'oo aa yarka'oon
en: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailunny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
tr: Fabi ayyi hadeesim ba'dahoo yu'minoon
en: In what statement, after this, will they believe?

ar: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
tr: 'Amma Yatasaa-aloon
en: Whereof do they question one another?

ar: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
tr: 'Anin-nabaa-il 'azeem
en: (It is) of the awful tidings,

ar: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
tr: Allazi hum feehi mukh talifoon
en: Concerning which they are in disagreement.

ar: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
tr: Kallaa sa y'alamoon
en: Nay, but they will come to know!

ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
tr: Thumma kallaa sa y'alamoon
en: Nay, again, but they will come to know!

ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
tr: Alam naj'alil arda mihaa da
en: Have We not made the earth an expanse,

ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
tr: Wal jibaala au taada
en: And the high hills bulwarks?

ar: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
tr: Wa khalaq naakum azwaaja
en: And We have created you in pairs,

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
tr: Waja'alnan naumakum subata
en: And have appointed your sleep for repose,

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
tr: Waja'alnal laila libasa
en: And have appointed the night as a cloak,

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
tr: Waja'alnan nahara ma 'aasha
en: And have appointed the day for livelihood.

ar: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
tr: Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada
en: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
tr: Waja'alna siraajaw wah haaja
en: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,

ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
tr: Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja
en: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,

ar: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
tr: Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata
en: Thereby to produce grain and plant,

ar: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
tr: Wa jan naatin alfafa
en: And gardens of thick foliage.

ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
tr: Inna yaumal-fasli kana miqaata
en: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
tr: Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja
en: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,

ar: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
tr: Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba
en: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,

ar: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
tr: Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba
en: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.

ar: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
tr: Inna jahan nama kaanat mirsaada
en: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,

ar: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
tr: Lit taa gheena ma aaba
en: A home for the rebellious.

ar: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
tr: Laa bitheena feehaa ahqaaba
en: They will abide therein for ages.

ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
tr: Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba
en: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink

ar: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
tr: Illa hamee maw-wa ghas saaqa
en: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:

ar: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
tr: Jazaa-aw wi faaqa
en: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).

ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
tr: Innahum kaanu laa yarjoona hisaaba
en: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;

ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
tr: Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba
en: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.

ar: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
tr: Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba
en: Everything have We recorded in a Book.

ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
tr: Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba
en: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.

ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
tr: Inna lil mutta qeena mafaaza
en: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -

ar: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
tr: Hadaa-iqa wa a'anaa ba
en: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,

ar: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
tr: Wa kaawa 'iba at raaba
en: And voluptuous women of equal age;

ar: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
tr: Wa ka'san di haaqa
en: And a full cup.

ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
tr: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba
en: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -

ar: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
tr: Jazaa-am mir-rabbika ataa-an hisaaba
en: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -

ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
tr: Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba
en: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.

ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
tr: Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba
en: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.

ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
tr: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba
en: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.

ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
tr: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba
en: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"

ar: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
tr: Wan naazi 'aati gharqa
en: By those who drag forth to destruction,

ar: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
tr: Wan naa shi taati nashta
en: By the meteors rushing,

ar: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
tr: Wass saabi-haati sabha
en: By the lone stars floating,

ar: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
tr: Fass saabi qaati sabqa
en: By the angels hastening,

ar: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
tr: Fal mu dab-bi raati amra
en: And those who govern the event,

ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
tr: Yawma tarjufur raajifa
en: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.

ar: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
tr: Tatba'u har raadifa
en: And the second followeth it,

ar: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
tr: Quloobuny-yau maaiziw-waaji-fa
en: On that day hearts beat painfully

ar: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
tr: Absaa ruhaa khashi'ah
en: While eyes are downcast

ar: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
tr: Ya qoo loona a-inna lamar doo doona fil haafirah
en: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state

ar: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
tr: Aizaa kunna 'izaa man-nakhirah
en: Even after we are crumbled bones?

ar: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
tr: Qaalu tilka izan karratun khaasirah.
en: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.

ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
tr: Fa inna ma hiya zajratuw-waahida
en: Surely it will need but one shout,

ar: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
tr: Faizaa hum biss saahirah
en: And lo! they will be awakened.

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
tr: Hal ataaka hadeethu Musaa
en: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?

ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
tr: Iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil waadil-muqad dasi tuwa
en: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,

ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
tr: Izhab ilaa fir'auna innahu taghaa.
en: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -

ar: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
tr: Faqul hal laka ilaa-an tazakka.
en: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?

ar: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
tr: Wa ahdi yaka ila rabbika fatakh sha
en: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).

ar: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
tr: Fa araahul-aayatal kubra.
en: And he showed him the tremendous token.

ar: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
tr: Fa kazzaba wa asaa.
en: But he denied and disobeyed,

ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
tr: Thumma adbara yas'aa.
en: Then turned he away in haste,

ar: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
tr: Fa hashara fanada.
en: Then gathered he and summoned

ar: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
tr: Faqala ana rabbu kumul-a'laa.
en: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."

ar: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
tr: Fa-akha zahul laahu nakalal aakhirati wal-oola.
en: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
tr: Inna fee zaalika la'ibratal limaiy-yaksha
en: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.

ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
tr: A-antum a shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha.
en: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?

ar: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
tr: Raf'a sam kaha fasaw waaha
en: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;

ar: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
tr: Wa aghtasha lailaha wa akhraja duhaaha.
en: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
tr: Wal arda b'ada zaalika dahaaha.
en: And after that He spread the earth,

ar: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
tr: Akhraja minha maa-aha wa mar 'aaha.
en: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,

ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
tr: Wal jibala arsaaha.
en: And He made fast the hills,

ar: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
tr: Mataa'al lakum wali an 'aamikum.
en: A provision for you and for your cattle.

ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
tr: Fa-izaa jaaa'atit taaam matul kubraa.
en: But when the great disaster cometh,

ar: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
tr: Yauma Yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa.
en: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,

ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
tr: Wa burrizatil-jaheemu limany-yaraa.
en: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,

ar: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
tr: Fa ammaa man taghaa.
en: Then, as for him who rebelled

ar: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
tr: Wa aasaral hayaatad dunyaa
en: And chose the life of the world,

ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
tr: Fa innal jaheema hiyal maawaa.
en: Lo! hell will be his home.

ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
tr: Wa ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee wa nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa
en: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,

ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
tr: Fa innal jannata hiyal maawaa
en: Lo! the Garden will be his home.

ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
tr: Yas'aloonaka 'anis saa'ati ayyaana mursaahaa
en: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?

ar: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
tr: Feema anta min zikraahaa
en: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?

ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
tr: Ilaa Rabbika muntahaa haa
en: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.

ar: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
tr: Innamaaa anta munziru maiy yakshaahaa
en: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.

ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
tr: Ka annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa
en: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.

ar: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
tr: 'Abasa wa tawallaa.
en: He frowned and turned away

ar: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
tr: An jaa-ahul 'a-maa
en: Because the blind man came unto him.

ar: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
tr: Wa maa yudreeka la'allahu yaz zakkaa.
en: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)

ar: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
tr: Au yaz zak karu fatanfa 'ahuz zikraa.
en: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?

ar: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
tr: Amma manis taghnaa
en: As for him who thinketh himself independent,

ar: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
tr: Fa-anta lahu tasaddaa
en: Unto him thou payest regard.

ar: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
tr: Wa ma 'alaika allaa yaz zakka.
en: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).

ar: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
tr: Wa amma man jaa-aka yas'a
en: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose

ar: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
tr: Wahuwa yakhshaa,
en: And hath fear,

ar: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
tr: Fa-anta 'anhu talah haa.
en: From him thou art distracted.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
tr: Kalla innaha tazkirah
en: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,

ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
tr: Faman shaa a zakarah
en: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,

ar: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
tr: Fi suhufim mukar rama,
en: On honoured leaves

ar: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
tr: Marfoo'atim mutah hara,
en: Exalted, purified,

ar: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
tr: Bi'aidee safara
en: (Set down) by scribes

ar: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
tr: Kiraamim bararah.
en: Noble and righteous.

ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
tr: Qutilal-insanu maa akfarah.
en: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!

ar: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
tr: Min aiyyi shai-in Khalaq
en: From what thing doth He create him?

ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
tr: Min nutfah; khalaqahu faqad-darah.
en: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,

ar: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
tr: Thummas sabeela yas-sarah
en: Then maketh the way easy for him,

ar: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
tr: Thumma amatahu fa-aqbarah
en: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;

ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
tr: Thumma iza shaa-a ansharah
en: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.

ar: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
tr: Kalla lamma yaqdi maa amarah.
en: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.

ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
tr: Falyanzuril insanu ilaa ta-amih
en: Let man consider his food:

ar: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
tr: Anna sabab nalmaa-a sabba.
en: How We pour water in showers

ar: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
tr: Thumma sha qaqnal-arda shaqqa.
en: Then split the earth in clefts

ar: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
tr: Fa ambatna feeha habba
en: And cause the grain to grow therein

ar: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
tr: Wa 'inabaw-wa qadba
en: And grapes and green fodder

ar: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
tr: Wa zaitoonaw wanakh la'
en: And olive-trees and palm-trees

ar: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
tr: Wa hadaa-iqa ghulba
en: And garden-closes of thick foliage

ar: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
tr: Wa faki hataw-wa abba.
en: And fruits and grasses:

ar: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
tr: Mata'al-lakum wa li-an'amikum.
en: Provision for you and your cattle.

ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
tr: Faiza jaa-atis saakhah.
en: But when the Shout cometh

ar: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
tr: Yauma yafir-rul mar-u min akheeh
en: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother

ar: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
tr: Wa ummihee wa abeeh
en: And his mother and his father

ar: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
tr: Wa sahi batihee wa baneeh.
en: And his wife and his children,

ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
tr: Likul limri-im-minuhm yaumaa-izin shaa nuy-yughneeh
en: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).

ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
tr: Wujoo huny-yauma-izim-musfira;
en: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,

ar: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
tr: Dahi katum mustab shirah
en: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;

ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
tr: Wa wujoohuy yauma-izin 'alaiha ghabar a
en: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,

ar: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
tr: Tarhaquha qatarah.
en: Veiled in darkness,

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
tr: Ulaa-ika humul-kafa ratul-fajarah.
en: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.

ar: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
tr: Izash shamsu kuwwirat
en: When the sun is overthrown,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
tr: Wa izan nujoomun kadarat
en: And when the stars fall,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
tr: Wa izal jibaalu suyyirat
en: And when the hills are moved,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
tr: Wa izal 'ishaaru 'uttilat
en: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
tr: Wa izal wuhooshu hushirat
en: And when the wild beasts are herded together,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
tr: Wa izal bihaaru sujjirat
en: And when the seas rise,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
tr: Wa izan nufoosu zuwwijat
en: And when souls are reunited,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
tr: Wa izal maw'oodatu su'ilat
en: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked

ar: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
tr: Bi ayyi zambin qutilat
en: For what sin she was slain,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
tr: Wa izas suhufu nushirat
en: And when the pages are laid open,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
tr: Wa izas samaaa'u kushitat
en: And when the sky is torn away,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
tr: Wa izal jaheemu su'-'irat
en: And when hell is lighted,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
tr: Wa izal jannatu uzlifat
en: And when the Garden is brought nigh,

ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
tr: 'Alimat nafsum maaa ahdarat
en: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.

ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
tr: Falaaa uqsimu bil khunnas
en: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,

ar: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
tr: Al jawaaril kunnas
en: The stars which rise and set,

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
tr: Wallaili izaa 'as'as
en: And the close of night,

ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
tr: Wassubhi izaa tanaffas
en: And the breath of morning

ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
tr: Innahoo laqawlu rasoolin kareem
en: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,

ar: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
tr: Zee quwwatin 'inda zil 'arshi makeen
en: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,

ar: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
tr: Mutaa'in samma ameen
en: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;

ar: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
tr: Wa maa saahibukum bimajnoon
en: And your comrade is not mad.

ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
tr: Wa laqad ra aahu bilufuqil mubeen
en: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.

ar: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
tr: Wa maa huwa 'alal ghaibi bidaneen
en: And he is not avid of the Unseen.

ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
tr: Wa maa huwa biqawli shaitaanir rajeem
en: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.

ar: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
tr: Fa ayna tazhaboon
en: Whither then go ye?

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: In huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen
en: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,

ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
tr: Liman shaaa'a minkum ai yastaqeem
en: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.

ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaaa ai yashaaa 'al laahu Rabbul 'Aalameen
en: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.

ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
tr: Izas samaaa'un fatarat
en: When the heaven is cleft asunder,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
tr: Wa izal kawaakibun tasarat
en: When the planets are dispersed,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
tr: Wa izal bihaaru fujjirat
en: When the seas are poured forth,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
tr: Wa izal qubooru bu'sirat
en: And the sepulchres are overturned,

ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
tr: 'Alimat nafsum maa qaddamat wa akhkharat
en: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
tr: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem
en: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
tr: Allazee khalaqaka fasaw waaka fa'adalak
en: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?

ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
tr: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak
en: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.

ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
tr: Kalla bal tukazziboona bid deen
en: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.

ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
tr: Wa inna 'alaikum lahaa fizeen
en: Lo! there are above you guardians,

ar: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
tr: Kiraaman kaatibeen
en: Generous and recording,

ar: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
tr: Ya'lamoona ma taf'aloon
en: Who know (all) that ye do.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
tr: Innal abraara lafee na'eem
en: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.

ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
tr: Wa innal fujjaara lafee jaheem
en: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;

ar: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
tr: Yaslawnahaa Yawmad Deen
en: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,

ar: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
tr: Wa maa hum 'anhaa bighaaa 'ibeen
en: And will not be absent thence.

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
tr: Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen
en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
tr: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen
en: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
tr: Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah
en: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
tr: Wailul lil mutaffifeen
en: Woe unto the defrauders:

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
tr: Allazeena izak taaloo 'alan naasi yastawfoon
en: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,

ar: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
tr: Wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon
en: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.

ar: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
tr: Alaa yazunnu ulaaa'ika annahum mab'oosoon
en: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again

ar: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
tr: Li Yawmin 'Azeem
en: Unto an Awful Day,

ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
tr: Yawma yaqoomun naasu li Rabbil 'aalameen
en: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
tr: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen
en: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
tr: Wa maa adraaka maa Sijjeen
en: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -

ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
tr: Kitaabum marqoom
en: A written record.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
tr: Wailuny yawma'izil lil mukazzibeen
en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
tr: Allazeena yukazziboona bi yawmid deen
en: Those who deny the Day of Judgment

ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
tr: Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem
en: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,

ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
tr: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen
en: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.

ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
tr: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon
en: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
tr: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon
en: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
tr: Summa innahum lasaa lul jaheem
en: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,

ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
tr: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon
en: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
tr: Kallaaa inna kitaabal abraari lafee'Illiyyeen
en: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
tr: Wa maaa adraaka maa 'Illiyyoon
en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -

ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
tr: Kitaabum marqoom
en: A written record,

ar: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
tr: Yashhadu hul muqarra boon
en: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
tr: Innal abraara lafee Na'eem
en: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,

ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
tr: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon
en: On couches, gazing,

ar: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
tr: Ta'rifu fee wujoohihim nadratan na'eem
en: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.

ar: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
tr: Yusqawna mir raheeqim makhtoom
en: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,

ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
tr: Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon
en: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -

ar: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
tr: Wa mizaajuhoo min Tasneem
en: And mixed with water of Tasnim,

ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
tr: 'Ainaiy yashrabu bihal muqarraboon
en: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
tr: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon
en: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,

ar: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
tr: Wa izaa marroo bihim yataghaamazoon
en: And wink one to another when they passed them;

ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
tr: Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen
en: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;

ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
tr: Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon
en: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.

ar: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
tr: Wa maaa ursiloo 'alaihim haafizeen
en: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.

ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
tr: Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon
en: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,

ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
tr: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon
en: On high couches, gazing.

ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
tr: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon
en: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?

ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
tr: Izas samaaa'un shaqqat
en: When the heaven is split asunder

ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
tr: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat
en: And attentive to her Lord in fear,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
tr: Wa izal ardu muddat
en: And when the earth is spread out

ar: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
tr: Wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat
en: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty

ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
tr: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat
en: And attentive to her Lord in fear!

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
tr: Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh
en: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).

ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
tr: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih
en: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand

ar: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
tr: Fasawfa yuhaasabu hi saabai yaseeraa
en: He truly will receive an easy reckoning

ar: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
tr: Wa yanqalibu ilaaa ahlihee masrooraa
en: And will return unto his folk in joy.

ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
tr: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih
en: But whoso is given his account behind his back,

ar: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
tr: Fasawfa yad'oo subooraa
en: He surely will invoke destruction

ar: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
tr: Wa yaslaa sa'eeraa
en: And be thrown to scorching fire.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
tr: Innahoo kaana feee ahlihee masrooraa
en: He verily lived joyous with his folk,

ar: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
tr: Innahoo zanna al lai yahoor
en: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).

ar: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
tr: Balaaa inna Rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa
en: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!

ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
tr: Falaaa uqsimu bishshafaq
en: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
tr: Wallaili wa maa wasaq
en: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,

ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
tr: Walqamari izat tasaq
en: And by the moon when she is at the full,

ar: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
tr: Latarkabunna tabaqan 'an tabaq
en: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.

ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
tr: Famaa lahum laa yu'minoon
en: What aileth them, then, that they believe not

ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
tr: Wa izaa quri'a 'alaihimul Quraanu laa yasjudoon
en: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?

ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
tr: Balil lazeena kafaroo yukazziboon
en: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;

ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
tr: Wallaahu a'lamu bimaa yoo'oon
en: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.

ar: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
tr: Fabashshirhum bi'azaabin aleem
en: So give them tidings of a painful doom,

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
tr: Illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon
en: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
tr: Wassamaaa'i zaatil burooj
en: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,

ar: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
tr: Wal yawmil maw'ood
en: And by the Promised Day.

ar: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
tr: Wa shaahidinw wa mashhood
en: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,

ar: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
tr: Qutila as haabul ukhdood
en: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

ar: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
tr: Annaari zaatil waqood
en: Of the fuel-fed fire,

ar: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
tr: Iz hum 'alaihaa qu'ood
en: When they sat by it,

ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
tr: Wa hum 'alaa maa yaf'aloona bilmu 'mineena shuhood
en: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.

ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
tr: Wa maa naqamoo minhum illaaa aiyu'minoo billaahil 'azeezil Hameed
en: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,

ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
tr: Allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai 'in Shaheed
en: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
tr: Innal lazeena fatanul mu'mineena wal mu'minaati summa lam yatooboo falahum 'azaabu Jahannama wa lahum 'azaabul hareeq
en: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
tr: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum Jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal fawzul kabeer
en: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.

ar: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
tr: Inna batsha Rabbika lashadeed
en: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
tr: Innahoo Huwa yubdi'u wa yu'eed
en: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
tr: Wa Huwal Ghafoorul Wadood
en: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,

ar: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
tr: Zul 'Arshil Majeed
en: Lord of the Throne of Glory,

ar: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
tr: Fa' 'aalul limaa yureed
en: Doer of what He will.

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
tr: Hal ataaka hadeesul junood
en: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts

ar: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
tr: Fir'awna wa Samood
en: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?

ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
tr: Balil lazeena kafaroo fee takzeeb
en: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial

ar: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
tr: Wallaahu minw waraaa'ihim muheet
en: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.

ar: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
tr: Bal huwa Quraanum Majeed
en: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.

ar: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
tr: Fee Lawhim Mahfooz
en: On a guarded tablet.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
tr: Wassamaaa'i wattaariq
en: By the heaven and the Morning Star

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
tr: Wa maaa adraaka mattaariq
en: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!

ar: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
tr: Annajmus saaqib
en: - The piercing Star!

ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
tr: In kullu nafsil lammaa 'alaihaa haafiz
en: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.

ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
tr: Fal yanzuril insaanu mimma khuliq
en: So let man consider from what he is created.

ar: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
tr: Khuliqa mim maaa'in daafiq
en: He is created from a gushing fluid

ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
tr: Yakhruju mim bainissulbi wat taraaa'ib
en: That issued from between the loins and ribs.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
tr: Innahoo 'alaa raj'ihee laqaadir
en: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)

ar: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
tr: Yawma tublas saraaa'ir
en: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.

ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
tr: Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir
en: Then will he have no might nor any helper.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
tr: Wassamaaa'i zaatir raj'
en: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
tr: Wal ardi zaatis sad'
en: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)

ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
tr: Innahoo laqawlun fasl
en: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,

ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
tr: Wa maa huwa bil hazl
en: It is no pleasantry.

ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
tr: Innahum yakeedoona kaidaa
en: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)

ar: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
tr: Wa akeedu kaidaa
en: And I plot a plot (against them).

ar: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
tr: Famahhilil kaafireena amhilhum ruwaidaa
en: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.

ar: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
tr: Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'laa
en: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
tr: Allazee khalaqa fasawwaa
en: Who createth, then disposeth;

ar: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
tr: Wallazee qaddara fahadaa
en: Who measureth, then guideth;

ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
tr: Wallazeee akhrajal mar'aa
en: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,

ar: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
tr: Faja'alahoo ghusaaa'an ahwaa
en: Then turneth it to russet stubble.

ar: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
tr: Sanuqri'uka falaa tansaaa
en: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget

ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
tr: Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa
en: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;

ar: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
tr: Wa nu-yassiruka lilyusraa
en: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.

ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
tr: Fazakkir in nafa'atizzikraa
en: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.

ar: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
tr: Sa yazzakkaru maiyakhshaa
en: He will heed who feareth,

ar: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
tr: Wa yatajannabuhal ashqaa
en: But the most hapless will flout it,

ar: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
tr: Allazee yaslan Naaral kubraa
en: He who will be flung to the great Fire

ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
tr: Summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa
en: Wherein he will neither die nor live.

ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
tr: Qad aflaha man tazakkaa
en: He is successful who groweth,

ar: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
tr: Wa zakaras ma Rabbihee fasallaa
en: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,

ar: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
tr: Bal tu'siroonal hayaatad dunyaa
en: But ye prefer the life of the world

ar: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
tr: Wal Aakhiratu khairunw wa abqaa
en: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
tr: Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa
en: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.

ar: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
tr: Suhufi Ibraaheema wa Moosaa
en: The Books of Abraham and Moses.

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
tr: Hal ataaka hadeesul ghaashiyah
en: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?

ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
tr: Wujoohuny yawma 'izin khaashi'ah
en: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,

ar: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
tr: 'Aamilatun naasibah
en: Toiling, weary,

ar: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
tr: Taslaa naaran haamiyah
en: Scorched by burning fire,

ar: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
tr: Tusqaa min 'aynin aaniyah
en: Drinking from a boiling spring,

ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
tr: Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree'
en: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit

ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
tr: Laa yusminu wa laa yughnee min joo'
en: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.

ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
tr: Wujoohuny yawma 'izin naa'imah
en: In that day other faces will be calm,

ar: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
tr: Lisa'yihaa raadiyah
en: Glad for their effort past,

ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
tr: Fee jannatin 'aaliyah
en: In a high Garden

ar: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
tr: Laa tasma'u feehaa laaghiyah
en: Where they hear no idle speech,

ar: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
tr: Feehaa 'aynun jaariyah
en: Wherein is a gushing spring,

ar: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
tr: Feehaa sururum marfoo'ah
en: Wherein are couches raised

ar: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
tr: Wa akwaabum mawdoo 'ah
en: And goblets set at hand

ar: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
tr: Wa namaariqu masfoofah
en: And cushions ranged

ar: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
tr: Wa zaraabiyyu mabsoosah
en: And silken carpets spread.

ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
tr: Afalaa yanzuroona ilalibili kaifa khuliqat
en: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?

ar: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
tr: Wa ilas samaaa'i kaifa rufi'at
en: And the heaven, how it is raised?

ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
tr: Wa ilal jibaali kaifa nusibat
en: And the hills, how they are set up?

ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
tr: Wa ilal ardi kaifa sutihat
en: And the earth, how it is spread?

ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
tr: Fazakkir innama anta Muzakkir
en: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,

ar: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
tr: Lasta 'alaihim bimusaitir
en: Thou art not at all a warder over them.

ar: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
tr: Illaa man tawallaa wa kafar
en: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,

ar: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
tr: Fa yu'azzibuhul laahul 'azaabal akbar
en: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.

ar: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
tr: Innaa ilainaaa iyaabahum
en: Lo! unto Us is their return

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
tr: Summa inna 'alainaa hisaabahum
en: And Ours their reckoning.

ar: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
tr: Wal-Fajr
en: By the Dawn

ar: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
tr: Wa layaalin 'ashr
en: And ten nights,

ar: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
tr: Wash shaf'i wal watr
en: And the Even and the Odd,

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
tr: Wallaili izaa yasr
en: And the night when it departeth,

ar: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
tr: Hal fee zaalika qasamul lizee hijr
en: There surely is an oath for thinking man.

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
tr: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi'aad
en: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,

ar: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
tr: Iramaa zaatil 'imaad
en: With many-columned Iram,

ar: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
tr: Allatee lam yukhlaq misluhaa fil bilaad
en: The like of which was not created in the lands;

ar: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
tr: Wa samoodal lazeena jaabus sakhra bil waad
en: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;

ar: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
tr: Wa fir'awna zil awtaad
en: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
tr: Allazeena taghaw fil bilaad
en: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,

ar: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
tr: Fa aksaroo feehal fasaad
en: And multiplied iniquity therein?

ar: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
tr: Fasabba 'alaihim Rabbuka sawta 'azaab
en: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
tr: Inna Rabbaka labil mirsaad
en: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.

ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
tr: Fa ammal insaanu izaa mab talaahu Rabbuhoo fa akramahoo wa na' 'amahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee akraman
en: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.

ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
tr: Wa ammaaa izaa mabtalaahu faqadara 'alaihi rizqahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee ahaanan
en: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.

ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
tr: Kalla bal laa tukrimooo nal yateem
en: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan

ar: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
tr: Wa laa tahaaaddoona 'alaata'aamil miskeen
en: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.

ar: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
tr: Wa taakuloonat turaasa aklal lammaa
en: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.

ar: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
tr: Wa tuhibboonal maala hubban jammaa
en: And love wealth with abounding love.

ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
tr: Kallaaa izaaa dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka
en: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,

ar: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
tr: Wa jaaa'a Rabbuka wal malaku saffan saffaa
en: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,

ar: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
tr: Wa jeee'a yawma'izim bi jahannnam; Yawma 'iziny yatazakkarul insaanu wa annaa lahuz zikraa
en: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?

ar: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
tr: Yaqoolu yaa laitanee qaddamtu lihayaatee
en: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!

ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
tr: Fa Yawma izil laa yu'azzibu 'azaabahooo ahad
en: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!

ar: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
tr: Wa laa yoosiqu wasaaqa hooo ahad
en: None bindeth as He then will bind.

ar: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
tr: Yaaa ayyatuhan nafsul mutma 'innah
en: But ah! thou soul at peace!

ar: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
tr: Irji'eee ilaa Rabbiki raadiyatam mardiyyah
en: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!

ar: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
tr: Fadkhulee fee 'ibaadee
en: Enter thou among My bondmen!

ar: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
tr: Wadkhulee jannatee
en: Enter thou My Garden!

ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
tr: Laaa uqsimu bihaazal balad
en: Nay, I swear by this city -

ar: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
tr: Wa anta hillum bihaazal balad
en: And thou art an indweller of this city -

ar: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
tr: Wa waalidinw wa maa walad
en: And the begetter and that which he begat,

ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
tr: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee kabad
en: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
tr: Ayahsabu al-lai yaqdira 'alaihi ahad
en: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?

ar: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
tr: Yaqoolu ahlaktu maalal lubadaa
en: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
tr: Ayahsabu al lam yarahooo ahad
en: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?

ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
tr: Alam naj'al lahoo 'aynayn
en: Did We not assign unto him two eyes

ar: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
tr: Wa lisaananw wa shafatayn
en: And a tongue and two lips,

ar: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
tr: Wa hadaynaahun najdayn
en: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?

ar: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
tr: Falaq tahamal-'aqabah
en: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
tr: Wa maaa adraaka mal'aqabah
en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -

ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
tr: Fakku raqabah
en: (It is) to free a slave,

ar: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
tr: Aw it'aamun fee yawmin zee masghabah
en: And to feed in the day of hunger.

ar: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
tr: Yateeman zaa maqrabah
en: An orphan near of kin,

ar: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
tr: Aw miskeenan zaa matrabah
en: Or some poor wretch in misery,

ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
tr: Summa kaana minal lazeena aamanoo wa tawaasaw bissabri wa tawaasaw bilmarhamah
en: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
tr: Ulaaa'ika As-haabul maimanah
en: Their place will be on the right hand.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
tr: Wallazeena kafaroo bi aayaatinaa hum as-haabul Mash'amah
en: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.

ar: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
tr: Alaihim naarum mu'sadah
en: Fire will be an awning over them.

ar: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
tr: Wash shamsi wa duhaa haa
en: By the sun and his brightness,

ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
tr: Wal qamari izaa talaa haa
en: And the moon when she followeth him,

ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
tr: Wannahaari izaa jallaa haa
en: And the day when it revealeth him,

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
tr: Wallaili izaa yaghshaa haa
en: And the night when it enshroudeth him,

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
tr: Wassamaaa'i wa maa banaahaa
en: And the heaven and Him Who built it,

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
tr: Wal ardi wa maa tahaahaa
en: And the earth and Him Who spread it,

ar: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
tr: Wa nafsinw wa maa sawwaahaa
en: And a soul and Him Who perfected it

ar: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
tr: Fa-alhamahaa fujoorahaa wa taqwaahaa
en: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.

ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
tr: Qad aflaha man zakkaahaa
en: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,

ar: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
tr: Wa qad khaaba man dassaahaa
en: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.

ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
tr: Kazzabat Samoodu bi taghwaahaaa
en: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,

ar: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
tr: Izim ba'asa ashqaahaa
en: When the basest of them broke forth

ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
tr: Faqaala lahum Rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi wa suqiyaahaa
en: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
tr: Fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim Rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw waahaa
en: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).

ar: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
tr: Wa laa yakhaafu'uqbaahaa
en: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
tr: Wallaili izaa yaghshaa
en: By the night enshrouding

ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
tr: Wannahaari izaa tajalla
en: And the day resplendent

ar: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
tr: Wa maa khalaqaz zakara wal unthaa
en: And Him Who hath created male and female,

ar: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
tr: Inna sa'yakum lashattaa
en: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).

ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
tr: Fa ammaa man a'taa wattaqaa
en: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

ar: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
tr: Wa saddaqa bil husnaa
en: And believeth in goodness;

ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
tr: Fasanu yassiruhoo lilyusraa
en: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.

ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
tr: Wa ammaa mam bakhila wastaghnaa
en: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,

ar: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
tr: Wa kazzaba bil husnaa
en: And disbelieveth in goodness;

ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
tr: Fasanu yassiruhoo lil'usraa
en: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
