ar: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
tr: Wa maa yughnee 'anhu maaluhooo izaa taraddaa
en: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.

ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
tr: Inna 'alainaa lal hudaa
en: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance

ar: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
tr: Wa inna lanaa lal Aakhirata wal oolaa
en: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.

ar: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
tr: Fa anzartukum naaran talazzaa
en: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire

ar: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
tr: Laa yaslaahaaa illal ashqaa
en: Which only the most wretched must endure,

ar: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
tr: Allazee kazzaba wa tawallaa
en: He who denieth and turneth away.

ar: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
tr: Wa sa yujannnabuhal atqaa
en: Far removed from it will be the righteous

ar: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
tr: Allazee yu'tee maalahoo yatazakkaa
en: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).

ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
tr: Wa maa li ahadin 'indahoo min ni'matin tujzaaa
en: And none hath with him any favour for reward,

ar: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
tr: Illab tighaaa'a wajhi rabbihil a 'laa
en: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.

ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
tr: Wa lasawfa yardaa
en: He verily will be content.

ar: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
tr: Wad duhaa
en: By the morning hours

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
tr: Wal laili iza sajaa
en: And by the night when it is stillest,

ar: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
tr: Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa
en: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,

ar: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
tr: Walal-aakhiratu khairul laka minal-oola
en: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,

ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
tr: Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda
en: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.

ar: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
tr: Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa
en: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?

ar: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
tr: Wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada
en: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?

ar: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
tr: Wa wa jadaka 'aa-ilan fa aghnaa
en: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?

ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
tr: Fa am mal yateema fala taqhar
en: Therefor the orphan oppress not,

ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
tr: Wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar
en: Therefor the beggar drive not away,

ar: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
tr: Wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith
en: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.

ar: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
tr: Alam nashrah laka sadrak
en: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,

ar: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
tr: Wa wa d'ana 'anka wizrak
en: And eased thee of the burden

ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
tr: Allazee anqada zahrak
en: Which weighed down thy back;

ar: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
tr: Wa raf 'ana laka zikrak
en: And exalted thy fame?

ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
tr: Fa inna ma'al usri yusra
en: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,

ar: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
tr: Inna ma'al 'usri yusra
en: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;

ar: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
tr: Fa iza faragh ta fansab
en: So when thou art relieved, still toil

ar: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
tr: Wa ilaa rabbika far ghab
en: And strive to please thy Lord.

ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
tr: Wat teeni waz zaitoon
en: By the fig and the olive,

ar: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
tr: Wa toori sineen
en: By Mount Sinai,

ar: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
tr: Wa haazal balad-il ameen
en: And by this land made safe;

ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
tr: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem
en: Surely We created man of the best stature

ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
tr: Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen
en: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
tr: Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon
en: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.

ar: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
tr: Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen
en: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?

ar: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
tr: Alai sal laahu bi-ahkamil haakimeen
en: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?

ar: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
tr: Iqra bismi rab bikal lazee khalaq
en: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,

ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
tr: Khalaqal insaana min 'alaq
en: Createth man from a clot.

ar: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
tr: Iqra wa rab bukal akram
en: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,

ar: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
tr: Al lazee 'allama bil qalam
en: Who teacheth by the pen,

ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
tr: 'Al lamal insaana ma lam y'alam
en: Teacheth man that which he knew not.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
tr: Kallaa innal insaana layatghaa
en: Nay, but verily man is rebellious

ar: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
tr: Ar-ra aahus taghnaa
en: That he thinketh himself independent!

ar: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
tr: Innna ilaa rabbikar ruj'aa
en: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
tr: Ara-aital lazee yanhaa
en: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth

ar: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
tr: 'Abdan iza sallaa
en: A slave when he prayeth?

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
tr: Ara-aita in kana 'alal hudaa
en: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)

ar: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
tr: Au amara bit taqwaa
en: Or enjoineth piety?

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
tr: Ara-aita in kaz zaba wa ta walla
en: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?

ar: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
tr: Alam y'alam bi-an nal lahaa yaraa
en: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?

ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
tr: Kalla la illam yantahi la nasfa'am bin nasiyah
en: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -

ar: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
tr: Nasiyatin kazi batin khaatiyah
en: The lying, sinful forelock -

ar: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
tr: Fal yad'u naadiyah
en: Then let him call upon his henchmen!

ar: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
tr: Sanad 'uz zabaaniyah
en: We will call the guards of hell.

ar: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
tr: Kalla; la tuti'hu wasjud waqtarib
en: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).

ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
tr: Innaa anzalnaahu fee lailatil qadr
en: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
tr: Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr
en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!

ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
tr: Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr
en: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
tr: Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr
en: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.

ar: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
tr: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr
en: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.

ar: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
tr: Lam ya kunil lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena mun fak keena hattaa ta-tiya humul bayyinah
en: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,

ar: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
tr: Rasoolum minal laahi yatlu suhufam mutahharah
en: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages

ar: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
tr: Feeha kutubun qaiyimah
en: Containing correct scriptures.

ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
tr: Wa maa tafarraqal lazeena ootul kitaaba il-la mim b'adi ma jaa-at humul baiyyinah
en: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.

ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
tr: Wa maa umiroo il-la liy'abu dul laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena huna faa-a wa yuqeemus salaahta wa yu-tuz zakaata; wa zaalika deenul qaiyimah
en: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
tr: Innal lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena fee nari jahan nama khaali deena feeha; ulaa-ika hum shar rul ba reeyah
en: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
tr: Innal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saalihaati ula-ika hum khairul bareey yah
en: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.

ar: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
tr: Jazaa-uhum inda rabbihim jan naatu 'adnin tajree min tahtihal an haaru khalideena feeha abada; radiy-yallaahu 'anhum wa ra du 'an zaalika liman khashiya rabbah.
en: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.

ar: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
tr: Izaa zul zilatil ardu zil zaalaha
en: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake

ar: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
tr: Wa akh rajatil ardu athqaalaha
en: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
tr: Wa qaalal insaanu ma laha
en: And man saith: What aileth her?

ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
tr: Yawmaa izin tuhad dithu akhbaaraha
en: That day she will relate her chronicles,

ar: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
tr: Bi-anna rabbaka awhaa laha
en: Because thy Lord inspireth her.

ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
tr: Yawma iziy yas durun naasu ash tatal liyuraw a'maalahum
en: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.

ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
tr: Famaiy ya'mal mithqala zarratin khai raiy-yarah
en: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,

ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
tr: Wa maiy-y'amal mithqala zarratin sharraiy-yarah
en: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.

ar: وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
tr: Wal'aadi yaati dabha
en: By the snorting courses,

ar: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا
tr: Fal moori yaati qadha
en: Striking sparks of fire

ar: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا
tr: Fal mugheeraati subha
en: And scouring to the raid at dawn,

ar: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا
tr: Fa atharna bihee naq'a
en: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,

ar: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
tr: Fawa satna bihee jam'a
en: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ
tr: Innal-insana lirabbihee lakanood
en: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ
tr: Wa innahu 'alaa zaalika la shaheed
en: And lo! he is a witness unto that;

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
tr: Wa innahu lihubbil khairi la shadeed
en: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.

ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
tr: Afala ya'lamu iza b'uthira ma filquboor
en: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth

ar: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
tr: Wa hussila maa fis sudoor
en: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
tr: Inna rabbahum bihim yauma 'izil la khabeer
en: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.

ar: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
tr: Al qaari'ah
en: The Calamity!

ar: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
tr: Mal qaariah
en: What is the Calamity?

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
tr: Wa maa adraaka mal qaari'ah
en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!

ar: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
tr: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth
en: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths

ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
tr: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh
en: And the mountains will become as carded wool.

ar: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
tr: Fa-amma man thaqulat mawa zeenuh
en: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),

ar: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
tr: Fahuwa fee 'ishatir raadiyah
en: He will live a pleasant life.

ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
tr: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh
en: But as for him whose scales are light,

ar: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
tr: Fa-ummuhu haawiyah
en: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
tr: Wa maa adraaka maa hiyah
en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -

ar: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
tr: Naarun hamiyah
en: Raging Fire.

ar: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
tr: Al haaku mut takathur
en: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you

ar: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
tr: Hatta zurtumul-maqaabir
en: Until ye come to the graves.

ar: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
tr: Kalla sawfa ta'lamoon
en: Nay, but ye will come to know!

ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
tr: Thumma kalla sawfa ta'lamoon
en: Nay, but ye will come to know!

ar: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
tr: Kalla law ta'lamoona 'ilmal yaqeen
en: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!

ar: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
tr: Latara-wun nal jaheem
en: For ye will behold hell-fire.

ar: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
tr: Thumma latara wunnaha 'ainal yaqeen
en: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.

ar: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
tr: Thumma latus alunna yauma-izin 'anin na'eem
en: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.

ar: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
tr: Wal' asr
en: By the declining day,

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
tr: Innal insaana lafee khusr
en: Lo! man is a state of loss,

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
tr: Il lal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saali haati wa tawa saw bil haqqi wa tawa saw bis sabr
en: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
tr: Wai lul-li kulli hu mazatil-lumaza
en: Woe unto every slandering traducer,

ar: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
tr: Al-lazi jama'a maalaw wa'addadah
en: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.

ar: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
tr: Yahsabu anna maalahu akhladah
en: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.

ar: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
tr: Kalla layum ba zanna fil hutamah
en: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
tr: Wa maa adraaka mal-hutamah
en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!

ar: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
tr: Narul laahil-mooqada
en: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,

ar: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
tr: Al latee tat tali'u 'alalafidah
en: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).

ar: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ
tr: Innaha 'alaihim moosada
en: Lo! it is closed in on them

ar: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
tr: Fee 'amadim-mu mad dadah
en: In outstretched columns.

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
tr: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel
en: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?

ar: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ
tr: Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel
en: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,

ar: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
tr: Wa arsala 'alaihim tairan abaabeel
en: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,

ar: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ
tr: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel
en: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,

ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
tr: Faja 'alahum ka'asfim m'akool
en: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?

ar: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
tr: Li-ilaafi quraish
en: For the taming of Qureysh.

ar: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
tr: Elaafihim rihlatash shitaa-i wass saif
en: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.

ar: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
tr: Fal y'abudu rabba haazal-bait
en: So let them worship the Lord of this House,

ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
tr: Allazi at'amahum min ju'inw-wa-aamana hum min khawf
en: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
tr: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen
en: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?

ar: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
tr: Fa zaalikal lazi yadu'ul-yateem
en: That is he who repelleth the orphan,

ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
tr: Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen
en: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.

ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
tr: Fa wai lul-lil mu salleen
en: Ah, woe unto worshippers

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
tr: Al lazeena hum 'an salaatihim sahoon
en: Who are heedless of their prayer;

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
tr: Al lazeena hum yuraa-oon
en: Who would be seen (at worship)

ar: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
tr: Wa yamna'oonal ma'oon
en: Yet refuse small kindnesses!

ar: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
tr: Innaa a'taina kal kauthar
en: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;

ar: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
tr: Fa salli li rabbika wanhar
en: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.

ar: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
tr: Inna shani-aka huwal abtar
en: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.

ar: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
tr: Qul yaa-ai yuhal kaafiroon
en: Say: O disbelievers!

ar: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
tr: Laa a'budu ma t'abudoon
en: I worship not that which ye worship;

ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
tr: Wa laa antum 'aabidoona maa a'bud
en: Nor worship ye that which I worship.

ar: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
tr: Wa laa ana 'abidum maa 'abattum
en: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.

ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
tr: Wa laa antum 'aabidoona ma a'bud
en: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.

ar: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
tr: Lakum deenukum wa liya deen.
en: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.

ar: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
tr: Iza jaa-a nas rullahi walfath
en: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

ar: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
tr: Wa ra-aitan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwajah
en: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,

ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
tr: Fa sab bih bihamdi rabbika was taghfir, innahu kaana tawwaaba
en: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.

ar: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ
tr: Tab bat yadaa abee Lahabinw-wa tabb
en: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.

ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
tr: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa ma kasab
en: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.

ar: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ
tr: Sa yas laa naran zaata lahab
en: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,

ar: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
tr: Wam ra-atuh hamma latal-hatab
en: And his wife, the wood-carrier,

ar: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
tr: Fee jeediha hab lum mim-masad
en: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.

ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
tr: Qul huwal laahu ahad
en: Say: He is Allah, the One!

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
tr: Allah hus-samad
en: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!

ar: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
tr: Lam yalid wa lam yoolad
en: He begetteth not nor was begotten.

ar: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
tr: Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad
en: And there is none comparable unto Him.

ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
tr: Qul a'uzoo bi rabbil-falaq
en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak

ar: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
tr: Min sharri ma khalaq
en: From the evil of that which He created;

ar: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
tr: Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab
en: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,

ar: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
tr: Wa min sharrin-naffaa-thaati fil 'uqad
en: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,

ar: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
tr: Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad
en: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.

ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
tr: Qul a'uzu birabbin naas
en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

ar: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
tr: Malikin naas
en: The King of mankind,

ar: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
tr: Ilaahin naas
en: The god of mankind,

ar: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
tr: Min sharril was waasil khannaas
en: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,

ar: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
tr: Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas
en: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,

ar: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
tr: Minal jinnati wan naas
en: Of the jinn and of mankind.
